Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ SourceList: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Sources` | Default heading of the source list. |
| `citation(number: number, title: string)` | `Source 2: {title}` | Accessible name of a citation marker: "Source 2: Title". |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-bg`, `--ds-citation-size`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-fs-meta`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-lh-meta`, `--ds-line-control`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-source-list-gap`, `--ds-source-list-indent`, `--ds-source-list-padding`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-weight-medium`, `--ds-weight-semibold`

#### When to use

- An assistant answer that rests on documents, pages or records, and the owner should be able to check them.

#### When not to use

- Footnotes in long-form documents: use plain links.
- A list of results the user searched for: use a table or a list of cards.

#### Anatomy

```
p            ... a claim [2] ...        Citation: <a href="#s-source-b" aria-label="Source 2: Title">2</a>
section      named by its heading ("Sources")
  ol
    li       tabIndex=-1 (focus target)    title (link when it has a url) · domain (mono) · snippet
```

#### Accessibility

- A citation is a real link (`href="#..."`) named "Source 2: Title"; the visible text is the number, which the name contains.
- Activating it moves focus to the matching list item and scrolls it into view. It does not change the URL hash, so it does not fight your router. Without JavaScript the hash link still works.
- Source titles with a `url` are links that open in a new tab (with the external-link icon and a screen-reader note).
- The marker is 24 px square (WCAG 2.5.8).

#### Content rules

- Keep source order stable while the answer streams; append new sources at the end, so numbers already shown never change.
- Titles say what the page is, not "Click here". Snippets are short, plain text.

#### Example

```tsx
<p>
  Orders move through four statuses
  <Citation number={1} title="Order lifecycle" listId="answer-1" sourceId="lifecycle" />.
</p>
<SourceList
  id="answer-1"
  sources={[{ id: 'lifecycle', title: 'Order lifecycle', url: 'https://example.com/orders' }]}
/>
```

#### Related components

- Renders: Link

### Code

> Monospace code: inline in a sentence, or as a block (`pre` + `code`). A block that overflows
becomes a keyboard stop and a labelled region so it can be scrolled without a mouse.
It does not highlight syntax.

Monospace code: inline in a sentence, or a block (`pre` + `code`).

- Import: `import { Code } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Code/Code.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Typography/Code`): Default, Block, BlockScrolls, InlineLongToken, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'inline' \| 'block'` |  | `'inline'` | `inline` (default) is a `code` element inside running text. `block` renders a `pre` with a `code` inside it, keeps the whitespace, and scrolls sideways instead of wrapping. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Block only. Accessible name of the block when it scrolls and becomes a region. Defaults to "Code" from the message catalog; say what the code is when there are several ("Request body"). |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ blockLabel: string; }>` |  |  | Per-instance overrides of the built-in messages. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `variant`: `inline`, `block`

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Code: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blockLabel` | `Code` | Accessible name of a scrollable code block (a labelled region), when the consumer gives none. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-code-inline-padding-block`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line`, `--ds-line-control`, `--ds-line-subtle`, `--ds-radius-md`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-space-4`, `--ds-surface`, `--ds-text`

#### When to use

- Commands, identifiers, file names and short snippets in documentation or help text.
- A block for several lines, such as a request example.

#### When not to use

- For data values in the UI (IDs, amounts, shortcuts): use `Text mono`, or `Kbd` for a key.
- For syntax highlighting or a copy button: not part of this component.

#### Anatomy

```
code                 inline
pre > code           block (scrolls sideways, keeps whitespace)
```

#### Accessibility

- A block that overflows horizontally gets `tabindex="0"` and `role="region"` with a name, so keyboard users can scroll it (WCAG 2.1.1). A block that fits is a plain `pre`.
- Inline code wraps anywhere (`overflow-wrap: anywhere`) so a long token does not overflow at 320px.
- Block text is `--ds-text` on `--ds-surface` (≥ 4.5:1).

#### Internationalization

`blockLabel` has English and `pt-BR` ("Código") strings. Override per instance (`messages`), through `DSProvider`, or with `aria-label`.

#### Examples

```tsx
<p>Run <Code>pnpm check</Code> before you push.</p>

<Code variant="block" aria-label="Request example">
  {`curl -X POST https://api.example.com/v1/orders`}
</Code>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Kbd: For data values in the UI (IDs, amounts, shortcuts): use `Text mono`, or `Kbd` for a key.
- Used by: ToolCallStep

### ColorOption

> A selectable option that shows a color swatch and its name. It is a toggle button
(`aria-pressed`), so each option is chosen independently: put several in a
`role="group"` with an accessible name to pick any number of colors.
`isSelected` / `defaultSelected` / `onChange(isSelected)` follow React Aria.

Why a toggle and not a radio: the handoff uses it to pick several colors (a product's
available colors). To pick exactly one color, use `ChoiceTiles` or `RadioGroup` instead.

A selectable option that shows a color swatch and the color's name, with an optional short mark. It is a toggle button: each option is chosen on its own. Import it from `loui-ds/patterns`.

- Handoff source: `components/erp/ColorOption.jsx` (TODO `CMP-PAT-04`).

- Import: `import { ColorOption } from 'loui-ds/patterns';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/patterns/ColorOption/ColorOption.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Patterns/ColorOption`): Default, Selected, WithMark, SelectedWithMark, Disabled, DisabledSelected, LongLabel, LightColor, DarkColor, InAGroup, KeyboardToggle, RightToLeft, Focused

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `string` | yes |  | The color to show, as `#rgb` or `#rrggbb`. |
| `label` | `string` | yes |  | Name of the color ("Navy"). It is the accessible name of the option and is always visible. |
| `mark` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Optional short text after the label (a count, "Default", a code). It is part of the accessible name. While the option is selected and no `mark` is given, a check is shown instead. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the button. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLButtonElement>` |  |  | Ref to the underlying `<button>`. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaBaseButtonProps` (react-aria): `aria-controls`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-haspopup`, `preventFocusOnPress`
- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`
- From `ButtonProps` (react-aria): `isDisabled`
- From `DOMRenderProps` (react-aria-components): `render`
- From `FocusableDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `excludeFromTabOrder`
- From `FocusableProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoFocus`
- From `FocusEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBlur`, `onFocus`, `onFocusChange`
- From `HoverEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onHoverChange`, `onHoverEnd`, `onHoverStart`
- From `KeyboardEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onKeyDown`, `onKeyUp`
- From `PressEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onClick`, `onPress`, `onPressChange`, `onPressEnd`, `onPressStart`, `onPressUp`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- From `ToggleButtonProps` (react-aria-components): `id`
- From `ToggleButtonProps` (react-aria): `defaultSelected`, `isSelected`, `onChange`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-accent-soft`, `--ds-bg`, `--ds-control-h-md`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-meta`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-lh-meta`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line-control`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-md`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`

#### When to use

- Choose any number of colors from a list: the colors available for an item, the colors to filter by.
- When the color name must be visible next to the swatch.

#### When not to use

- To choose exactly one color: use `ChoiceTiles` or `RadioGroup` (radio semantics).
- A free-form color input: use a color field.
- To display a color with no interaction: use `Swatch`.

#### Semantics decision: toggle, not radio

The option exposes `aria-pressed` (a toggle button), not a radio. The handoff uses it for multi-select ("which colors does this item come in?"), and a radio group would force a single answer and a roving tab stop. React Aria `ColorSwatchPicker` was evaluated and does not fit: it is a single-select listbox of bare swatches with generated color names and no room for a visible label or mark. For single choice, use `ChoiceTiles`.

Group several options in `role="group"` with an `aria-label` ("Available colors"); every option is its own tab stop.

#### Anatomy

```
button[aria-pressed]
  Swatch (decorative)
  label
  mark | check            (mark text if given, otherwise a check while selected)
```

#### Accessibility

- `aria-pressed` states the selection; the selected look is also a doubled accent border, a soft fill and a check (not color alone).
- The swatch is decorative because the label names the color.
- Boundaries use `--ds-line-control` (3:1); hover brightens the border, never the fill. Focus: accent border and ring. Forced colors: `Highlight` border when selected.

#### Content rules

- Label is the color name in sentence case ("Brick red"); `mark` is two or three words at most.

#### Examples

```tsx
<div role="group" aria-label="Available colors">
  <ColorOption color="#1f3a93" label="Navy" isSelected={on.navy} onChange={set('navy')} />
  <ColorOption color="#c0392b" label="Brick red" mark="12 left" />
</div>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see ChoiceTiles: To choose exactly one color: use `ChoiceTiles` or `RadioGroup` (radio semantics).
- Instead, see RadioGroup: To choose exactly one color: use `ChoiceTiles` or `RadioGroup` (radio semantics).
- Instead, see Swatch: To display a color with no interaction: use `Swatch`.
- Renders: Icon, Swatch

### Combobox

> A text input with a filtered list of options in a popover (ARIA combobox pattern, built on
React Aria `ComboBox`): the input has `role="combobox"` with `aria-expanded`,
`aria-controls`, `aria-autocomplete="list"` and `aria-activedescendant`, so focus stays in
the input while the arrow keys move through the list.

Typing filters the options accent- and case-insensitively. `Enter` selects the highlighted
option, `Escape` closes the list and then restores the selected text, `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp`
open the list and move, `Home` / `End` move the caret in the input (React Aria keeps them for
text editing). With `allowsCustomValue` the typed text itself is a valid value.

Use it for long lists (10 or more options); for fewer prefer `Select`.

A text input with a filtered list of options in a popover (ARIA combobox pattern). Built on React Aria `ComboBox` (`Input`, `Button`, `Popover`, `ListBox`). Shared field behavior is in [Field](../Field/Field.md). Task: CMP-INP-01.

- Import: `import { Combobox } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Combobox/Combobox.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Combobox`): Default, Open, KeyboardContract, WithDescriptionAndMeta, SelectWithPointer, WithSelection, Sections, DisabledOption, NoResults, CustomValue, Loading, AsyncFromServer, Required, Invalid, Disabled, ReadOnly, Sizes, LongText

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly (ComboboxOption \| ComboboxGroup)[]` | yes |  | The options, or groups of options. Keep the order you want users to see (see Combobox.md). |
| `value` | `string \| null` |  |  | The selected option `value`; `null` means nothing is selected. Pair with `onChange`. |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| null` |  |  | The initially selected `value` when uncontrolled. |
| `onChange` | `((value: string \| null) => void)` |  |  | Called with the selected `value`, or `null` when the selection is cleared. |
| `filter` | `false \| ((label: string, query: string) => boolean)` |  |  | How options are matched against the typed text. Default: accent- and case-insensitive "contains" on the label (`matchesSearch`), so `cafe` finds `Café`. Pass your own function, or `false` to show `options` as given: use it when the list is loaded from a server as the user types (listen to `onInputChange`, update `options`, set `isLoading` meanwhile). |
| `isLoading` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Shows a spinner in the box and, when there are no options yet, a "Loading" row instead of "No results". The consumer owns the data: see `filter={false}` and `onInputChange`. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Helper text under the control. Linked with `aria-describedby`. |
| `errorMessage` | `FieldErrorMessage` |  |  | Error text, shown while the field is invalid and the error is displayed. See `Input`. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  | Text shown while the box is empty. Never a substitute for the label. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  | `'md'` | Control height: `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (default), `lg` 48px. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the field root. |
| `popoverClassName` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the popover that holds the options. |
| `inputClassName` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the `<input>` element. |
| `inputRef` | `Ref<HTMLInputElement>` |  |  | Ref to the `<input>` element. The `ref` prop points at the field root. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ noResults: string; loading: string; showOptions: string; } & { requiredMark: string; }>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance: `noResults`, `loading`, `showOptions`, `requiredMark`. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the field root `<div>`. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Visible label. Prefer it: sighted and assistive technology users see the same name. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label (for example a search box with an icon). |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the field. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaComboBoxProps` (react-aria): `shouldFocusWrap`
- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`
- From `CollectionBase` (@react-types/shared): `disabledKeys`
- From `ComboBoxProps` (react-stately): `allowsCustomValue`, `defaultInputValue`, `inputValue`, `menuTrigger`, `onInputChange`, `onOpenChange`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `FocusableProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoFocus`
- From `FocusEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBlur`, `onFocus`, `onFocusChange`
- From `InputBase` (@react-types/shared): `isDisabled`, `isReadOnly`
- From `InputDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `form`, `name`
- From `KeyboardEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onKeyDown`, `onKeyUp`
- From `RACValidation` (react-aria-components): `validationBehavior`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- From `Validation` (@react-types/shared): `isInvalid`, `isRequired`, `validate`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Combobox: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `noResults` | `No results` | Shown in the list when the typed text matches no option. |
| `loading` | `Loading` | Shown in the list while options are loading and there are none yet; also names the spinner. |
| `showOptions` | `Show options` | Accessible name of the button that opens the list. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-combobox-popover-max-height`, `--ds-field-control-padding-inline`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-item-h`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-lg`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-space-6`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-surface-raised`, `--ds-target-min`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-tracking-caption`, `--ds-z-dropdown`

#### When to use

- Choosing from a long list (10 or more options): customers, products, cities.
- Choosing from a list or typing a new value (`allowsCustomValue`).
- Options loaded from a server as the user types (see Async).

#### When not to use

- 2 to 4 options: `RadioGroup`. 4 to 9 options: `Select`.
- Searching the whole app or a table: `SearchInput`.
- Several selections: not supported yet (multiple selection is P3).

#### Props (key ones)

| Prop                                                                                                                | Notes                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` / `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`                                                                          | One is required.                                                                                                                |
| `options`                                                                                                           | `ComboboxOption[]` (`value`, `label`, `description`, `meta`, `isDisabled`) or groups `{ id, label, options }`.                  |
| `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value)`                                                                        | The selected option `value`, `null` for none.                                                                                   |
| `inputValue` / `defaultInputValue` / `onInputChange`                                                                | The text in the box (React Aria props, passed through).                                                                         |
| `allowsCustomValue`                                                                                                 | The typed text is a valid value; the form then receives the text.                                                               |
| `filter`                                                                                                            | Default accent- and case-insensitive "contains" on the label (`matchesSearch`). A function, or `false` for no client filtering. |
| `isLoading`                                                                                                         | Spinner in the box; "Loading" row when there are no options yet.                                                                |
| `menuTrigger`                                                                                                       | `input` (default), `focus` or `manual`.                                                                                         |
| `description`, `errorMessage`, `size`, `placeholder`, `name`, `isRequired`, `isInvalid`, `isDisabled`, `isReadOnly` | As in `Select`.                                                                                                                 |
| `messages`                                                                                                          | `noResults`, `loading`, `showOptions`, `requiredMark`.                                                                          |

Option order is yours (see `Select.md`): sort with `sortByText` unless the order carries meaning.

#### Async options (documented pattern; a full async list is P2)

Set `filter={false}`, keep the query from `onInputChange`, fetch, and pass the result as `options` with `isLoading` meanwhile. The component never fetches and does not virtualize; for thousands of options filter on the server.

#### Accessibility and keyboard

| Key                     | Behavior                                                                                         |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Typing                  | Opens the list and filters                                                                       |
| `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` | Open the list (first / last option) and move; focus stays in the input (`aria-activedescendant`) |
| `Enter`                 | Select the highlighted option and close                                                          |
| `Escape`                | Close the list; pressed again, restore the selected text (clear with `allowsCustomValue`)        |
| `Home` / `End`          | Move the caret in the input (React Aria keeps them for text editing, not for the list)           |
| `Tab`                   | Commit and leave                                                                                 |

The input has `role="combobox"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`. The chevron button ("Show options") is out of the tab order. While the list is open React Aria hides the rest of the page from assistive technology. An option's accessible name contains label, meta and description. The empty state is a single option-like row so screen readers announce it.

#### Content rules

Label with the noun ("Customer"). Empty state text is "No results" (sentence case, no punctuation); localize with `messages`.

#### Example

```tsx
<Combobox
  label="Customer"
  name="customer"
  options={sortByText(customers, (c) => c.label, locale)}
  onChange={setCustomerId}
/>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see RadioGroup: 2 to 4 options: `RadioGroup`. 4 to 9 options: `Select`.
- Instead, see Select: 2 to 4 options: `RadioGroup`. 4 to 9 options: `Select`.
- Instead, see SearchInput: Searching the whole app or a table: `SearchInput`.
- Renders: FieldMessages, Icon, Label, Spinner

### CommandPalette

> A command palette: a modal with a search field and a grouped list of commands, opened with
`Mod+K` (configurable). Built on React Aria `Autocomplete`, `SearchField` and `ListBox` inside a
`ModalOverlay`: the search field is a combobox that keeps focus while the arrow keys move
through the commands (`aria-activedescendant`), `Enter` runs the highlighted command and
closes, `Escape` closes and focus returns to where it was.

Search ignores case and accents and matches label, keywords and group. With `includeHotkeys`
it also lists the shortcuts registered through `useHotkeys`.

A modal search box that finds and runs commands from the keyboard. It opens with `Mod+K` (Command K on Apple platforms, Control K elsewhere), filters a grouped list as you type and runs the chosen command. It is the "⌘K for everything" of AGENTS.md section 5.

- Import: `import { CommandPalette } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/CommandPalette/CommandPalette.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/CommandPalette`): Default, Open, Filtered, Empty, WithRecent, GivenOrder, LongLabels, WithRegisteredHotkeys, Controlled, PortugueseBrazil, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `commands` | `readonly Command[]` | yes |  | The commands. Search covers the label, the keywords and the group. |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` |  |  | Controlled open state. Pair with `onOpenChange`. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| `onOpenChange` | `((isOpen: boolean) => void)` |  |  | Called when the palette opens (from the hotkey) or closes (Escape, outside press, a command ran). |
| `hotkey` | `string \| false` |  | `Mod+K` | The shortcut that opens the palette, registered in the hotkey registry. Default `'Mod+K'`. It works while an input has focus. Pass `false` to open the palette only through `isOpen`. |
| `includeHotkeys` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Also list every shortcut registered with `useHotkeys` that has a `description`, as a command that runs its handler (grouped by the shortcut's `group`, or under "Shortcuts"). A registered shortcut whose description equals a command's label is listed once. Default `false`. |
| `recentIds` | `readonly string[]` |  |  | Ids of recently run commands, most recent first, shown under "Recent" while the search is empty. Persisting them is up to the app: collect them in `onRun`. |
| `maxRecent` | `number` |  | `5` | Most recent commands shown. Default `5`. |
| `onRun` | `((commandId: string) => void)` |  |  | Called after a command was chosen, with its id, so the app can update `recentIds`. |
| `sort` | `'alphabetical' \| 'given'` |  | `'alphabetical'` | Order of groups and commands. `alphabetical` (default) sorts both with the active locale, ignoring accents; `given` keeps the order of `commands` and lists groups in order of first use. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  | Placeholder and accessible name of the search field. Default from messages: "Search or run a command". |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ title: string; placeholder: string; commands: string; recent: string; ungrouped: string; shortcuts: string; noResults: string; noResultsHint: string; openDescription: string; openGroup: string; resultCount: (n: number) => string; }>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the palette panel. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLElement>` |  |  | Ref to the panel (`role="dialog"`). |

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ CommandPalette: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Command palette` | Accessible name of the palette dialog. |
| `placeholder` | `Search or run a command` | Placeholder and accessible name of the search field. |
| `commands` | `Commands` | Accessible name of the list of commands. |
| `recent` | `Recent` | Heading of the group of recently run commands. |
| `ungrouped` | `Commands` | Heading for commands that have no `group`. |
| `shortcuts` | `Shortcuts` | Heading for registered shortcuts that have no `group` (when `includeHotkeys` is set). |
| `noResults` | `No commands found` | Shown when no command matches the search. |
| `noResultsHint` | `Try another search term.` | Second line of the empty state: what to do next. |
| `openDescription` | `Open the command palette` | Description of the shortcut that opens the palette, listed by `ShortcutsHelp`. |
| `openGroup` | `General` | Group of the shortcut that opens the palette. |
| `resultCount(n: number)` | `2 commands` | Spoken after each search: how many commands match. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-command-palette-list-max-height`, `--ds-command-palette-offset-top`, `--ds-command-palette-width`, `--ds-control-h-lg`, `--ds-dialog-gutter`, `--ds-dialog-padding`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-body`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-item-h`, `--ds-lh-body`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-overlay`, `--ds-radius-lg`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-shadow-dialog`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-4`, `--ds-space-5`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-surface-raised`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-tracking-caption`, `--ds-weight-medium`

#### When to use

- An app with many actions or destinations that should all be reachable without the mouse: navigate, create, filter, switch.
- Together with `useHotkeys`, so every shortcut is also discoverable by name (`includeHotkeys`).

#### When not to use

- Searching data (orders, customers): use `SearchInput` with suggestions, or a results page. The palette runs commands; a command may open that search.
- Choosing a value in a form: use `Combobox` or `Select`.
- A short list of actions on one object: use `Menu`.

#### Anatomy

```
ModalOverlay (dims the page, dialog layer)
  Modal
    Dialog  role="dialog"  aria-label="Command palette"
      SearchField / Input  role="combobox"  (focus stays here)
      ListBox  role="listbox"  aria-label="Commands"
        Section "Recent"                (only while the search is empty)
        Section <group>
          Option  icon · label (match highlighted) · shortcut (Kbd)
      status    "3 commands"            (visually hidden live region)
```

#### Behavior

- Search matches the label, the `keywords` and the group, ignoring case and accents (`cafe` finds "Open café report"). The matching part of the label is highlighted. Disabled commands stay searchable but cannot run.
- The first command is highlighted when the palette opens and after each typed character, so `Enter` runs it at once. `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` move the highlight; focus stays in the field.
- `Enter` (or a click) runs the command and closes the palette. The command runs once the palette has unmounted, so a dialog it opens is not fought over by focus restoration.
- `Escape` always closes, even when the field has text (no "clear first" step), and focus returns to the element that had it.
- The search text resets every time the palette opens.
- Shortcuts of the page do not fire while the palette is open (see `docs/architecture/hotkeys.md`).
- `includeHotkeys`: a registered shortcut whose description equals a command's label is listed once (the command wins); the palette's own shortcut is not listed.

#### Accessibility

- A modal `dialog` named "Command palette". Focus is trapped, the page behind is inert, focus returns on close (React Aria).
- The field follows the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern with a listbox popup: `role="combobox"`, `aria-controls`, `aria-expanded="true"` and `aria-activedescendant` for the highlighted option. React Aria delays moving `aria-activedescendant` by about 500 ms while typing so screen readers are not interrupted by the highlight change.
- Groups are `role="group"` named by their heading. Disabled options are `aria-disabled`.
- After each search a visually hidden `role="status"` says how many commands match ("3 commands", "No commands found").
- Shortcuts are drawn with `Kbd`, which adds spoken key names ("Control Shift O") to the option's name.
- Keyboard: `Mod+K` opens, `↑ ↓` move, `Enter` runs, `Esc` closes. Hover highlights like the keyboard does.
- Motion honors `prefers-reduced-motion`; `forced-colors` gets a system border and highlight outline.

#### Content rules

- Labels are a verb plus an object in sentence case: "Create order", "Go to customers".
- Group names are nouns: "Navigation", "Orders". Use `keywords` for synonyms and other languages instead of long labels.
- Messages: `title`, `placeholder`, `commands`, `recent`, `ungrouped`, `shortcuts`, `noResults`, `noResultsHint`, `openDescription`, `openGroup`, `resultCount(n)`. English and pt-BR ship; override any of them per instance or through `DSProvider messages={{ CommandPalette: { ... } }}`.

#### Examples

```tsx
<HotkeyProvider>
  <CommandPalette
    commands={[
      {
        id: 'orders',
        label: 'Go to orders',
        group: 'Navigation',
        shortcut: '1',
        onAction: () => navigate('/orders'),
      },
      {
        id: 'new',
        label: 'Create order',
        group: 'Orders',
        keywords: ['invoice'],
        shortcut: 'F2',
        onAction: createOrder,
      },
    ]}
    includeHotkeys
    recentIds={recent}
    onRun={(id) => setRecent((ids) => [id, ...ids.filter((x) => x !== id)].slice(0, 5))}
  />
</HotkeyProvider>
```

Open it from a button instead of (or as well as) the hotkey:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
<Button onPress={() => setOpen(true)}>Commands</Button>
<CommandPalette commands={commands} isOpen={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} />
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see SearchInput: Searching data (orders, customers): use `SearchInput` with suggestions, or a results page. The palette runs commands; a command may open that search.
- Instead, see Combobox: Choosing a value in a form: use `Combobox` or `Select`.
- Instead, see Select: Choosing a value in a form: use `Combobox` or `Select`.
- Instead, see Menu: A short list of actions on one object: use `Menu`.
- Renders: Icon, Kbd, VisuallyHidden

### ConfirmDialog

> A destructive-action confirmation: an `alertdialog` with the question as the title, the
consequence in one sentence, a Cancel button and a confirm button that names the action.

Initial focus is on **Cancel**, so pressing Enter or Space right after the dialog opens never
confirms. Outside presses do not dismiss it (`Escape` and Cancel do), because the user has to
answer. Follow a confirmed delete with a `Toast` that offers Undo when the data can come back.

A modal dialog, and `ConfirmDialog` for destructive confirmations. Built on React Aria `DialogTrigger`, `ModalOverlay`, `Modal` and `Dialog`.

- Handoff source: `components/feedback/Dialog` (CMP-FBK-03). Overlay management: ARCH-005.

- Import: `import { ConfirmDialog } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Dialog/ConfirmDialog.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/ConfirmDialog`): Default, ConfirmByKeyboard, EscapeCancels, ConfirmFlow, Open, Neutral, Pending, WithDetails, Default, Open, Medium, Large, WithoutBody, LongContent, LongTitle, InsideSheet, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | yes |  | The question, naming the object: "Delete order #1048?". Not "Are you sure?" and not "Confirm". |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | yes |  | The consequence, in one sentence: "The order and its 14 lines will be removed. This can't be undone." Required, because a confirmation without a consequence is only a speed bump. |
| `confirmLabel` | `string` | yes |  | Label of the confirming button. Names the action, verb plus object: "Delete order". Never "OK", "Yes" or "Confirm". |
| `onConfirm` | `() => void` | yes |  | Called when the user confirms. The dialog closes afterwards unless `closeOnConfirm` is `false`. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Optional extra content between the description and the buttons (for example a list of affected items). |
| `tone` | `'danger' \| 'neutral'` |  | `'danger'` | `danger` (default): red `danger-solid` button for a destructive action. `neutral`: the `primary` button. |
| `initialFocus` | `'cancel' \| 'confirm'` |  | `'cancel'` | Which button gets the initial focus. `cancel` (default) is the safe choice and the product principle for destructive actions; `confirm` is for non-destructive confirmations. |
| `closeOnConfirm` | `boolean` |  | `true` | Keep the dialog open after `onConfirm`, for example while an async request runs. Default `true` closes it. |
| `isPending` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Shows a spinner on the confirm button and ignores presses while a request runs. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ cancel: string; }>` |  |  | Per-instance overrides of the built-in messages. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  |  | Maximum width: `sm` 420px (default), `md` 540px, `lg` 680px. Narrower on small screens. |
| `trigger` | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>>` |  |  | The element that opens the dialog (a `Button`). Optional: omit it and control the dialog with `isOpen`. Focus returns to the element that was focused when the dialog opened. |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` |  |  | Controlled open state. Pair with `onOpenChange`. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  |  | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(isOpen: boolean) => void` |  |  | Called when the dialog opens or closes. |
| `isDismissable` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Whether pressing the overlay closes the dialog. Default `true`; `ConfirmDialog` sets `false`. |
| `isKeyboardDismissDisabled` | `boolean` |  |  | Disables closing with `Escape`. Use it only while a request is running. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the dialog panel. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLElement>` |  |  | Ref to the dialog panel. |

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`
- `tone`: `danger`, `neutral`

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Dialog: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cancel` | `Cancel` | Label of the button that dismisses a `ConfirmDialog` without doing anything. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-dialog-gutter`, `--ds-dialog-padding`, `--ds-dialog-width-lg`, `--ds-dialog-width-md`, `--ds-dialog-width-sm`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-heading`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-lh-heading`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-overlay`, `--ds-radius-lg`, `--ds-shadow-dialog`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-space-4`, `--ds-surface-raised`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-weight-semibold`

#### When to use

- A short task or decision that blocks the page: edit a record in a small form, confirm a deletion.
- `ConfirmDialog`: every deletion. "Deleting always asks for confirmation" (AGENTS.md section 5).

#### When not to use

- Reversible actions (mark, link, change status): do them and offer **Undo** in a `Toast`. Do not confirm.
- Viewing or editing a record next to its list: use `Sheet`.
- Interactive content anchored to a control: use `Popover`.
- A message about the page: use `Alert`.
- Nesting dialogs more than two deep.

#### Anatomy

```
DialogTrigger
  trigger            Button                                (optional when controlled)
  ModalOverlay       --ds-overlay, z dialog
    Modal            raised surface, strong line, radius lg, dialog shadow, width sm | md | lg
      Dialog         role=dialog | alertdialog, aria-labelledby = title, aria-describedby = description
        header       h2 title (17/24, 600) · description (14/22, text-2)
        body         scrolls
        footer       actions aligned to the end; divider when there is a body
```

#### Accessibility

- Focus is **trapped** while open, **restored** to the element that opened it, the page behind is `inert`/`aria-hidden` and does not scroll (all React Aria).
- **Initial focus.** Plain `Dialog`: the dialog itself, or the child with `autoFocus` (put it on the first field). `ConfirmDialog`: **Cancel**, so pressing Enter or Space as soon as it opens never confirms. The handoff focused nothing.
- `Escape` closes **only the top-most layer**. A `Dialog` opened from a `Sheet` closes first and the Sheet stays (tested). Every overlay uses React Aria's shared layer stack instead of its own window listener (ARCH-005).
- Named by the title (`aria-labelledby`, from the `h2`) and described by the description (`aria-describedby`; not linked in the handoff).
- `ConfirmDialog` uses `alertdialog`, which screen readers announce with its description. A press outside does not dismiss it.
- Reduced motion: the 150 ms fade and 8 px rise are removed. Forced colors: border in `CanvasText`.
- 320 px reflow: the dialog shrinks to the viewport less the 24 px gutter and the body scrolls.

##### Layers

Overlays are portaled to `body`, each with its own layer: sheet (40) < dialog (45) < dropdown (50) < popover (55) < toast (58) < tooltip (60). A `Select`, `Menu`, `Popover` or `Combobox` opened from inside a Dialog or Sheet therefore renders **above** it. This is safe because a modal blocks page-level popovers while it is open. Tests assert the order.

#### Content rules

- Title: a question for confirmations that names the object ("Delete order #1048?"), otherwise verb plus object or a noun phrase ("Edit customer"). Sentence case, no exclamation marks.
- Description: the consequence in one sentence ("The order and its 14 lines will be removed. This can't be undone.").
- Buttons: Cancel (secondary) then the action, verb plus object ("Save customer", "Delete order"). Never "OK" or "Yes". One primary action.
- After a confirmed delete show a `Toast` with **Undo** when the data can come back.

#### Examples

```tsx
<ConfirmDialog
  trigger={<Button variant="danger">Delete order</Button>}
  title="Delete order #1048?"
  description="The order and its 14 lines will be removed. This can't be undone."
  confirmLabel="Delete order"
  onConfirm={() => deleteOrder(1048)}
/>

<Dialog
  trigger={<Button>Edit customer</Button>}
  title="Edit customer"
  footer={({ close }) => (
    <>
      <Button onPress={close}>Cancel</Button>
      <Button variant="primary" onPress={save}>Save customer</Button>
    </>
  )}
>
  <Input label="Name" autoFocus />
</Dialog>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Sheet: Viewing or editing a record next to its list: use `Sheet`.
- Instead, see Popover: Interactive content anchored to a control: use `Popover`.
- Instead, see Alert: A message about the page: use `Alert`.
- Renders: Button

### Container

> Centers page content and limits its line length: a maximum inline size plus a side gutter.
It carries no landmark role; put it inside `main`.

Centers page content and limits its line length: a maximum inline size and a side gutter.

- Import: `import { Container } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Container/Container.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Layout/Container`): Default, Small, Medium, Large, Full, NoGutter, Narrow, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'full'` |  |  | Maximum inline size: `sm` 640px, `md` 960px, `lg` 1200px (`--ds-container-*`), or `full` for no maximum. Default is the page content maximum (`--ds-content-max`, 1200px). |
| `gutter` | `boolean` |  | `true` | Adds the content gutter (`--ds-content-gutter`, 24px) as inline padding. Default `true`. |
| `as` | `'div' \| 'article' \| 'aside' \| 'footer' \| 'form' \| 'header' \| 'li' \| 'main' \| 'nav' \| 'ol' \| 'section' \| 'ul'` |  | `'div'` | Element to render, `div` by default. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `full`

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-container-lg`, `--ds-container-md`, `--ds-container-sm`, `--ds-content-gutter`, `--ds-content-max`

#### When to use

- Inside the `main` of a page to keep content readable on wide screens.
- Settings pages and forms (`size="sm"` or `"md"`), dashboards (`"lg"`).

#### When not to use

- Inside `Card`, `Dialog` or `Sheet`: those set their own padding.
- For full-bleed content such as a table: use `size="full"` or skip the container.

#### Anatomy

```
div (max-inline-size, margin-inline: auto, padding-inline: gutter)
  children
```

#### Responsive behavior

The container is `inline-size: 100%` up to its maximum, so it narrows with the viewport and keeps its gutter down to 320px.

#### Accessibility

- Carries no landmark role. The page's single `main` comes from `AppShell` (or your own `<main>`); put the container inside it.
- Logical properties (`margin-inline`, `padding-inline`) make it direction-neutral.

#### Examples

```tsx
<main id="main">
  <Container size="md">
    <Heading level={1}>Settings</Heading>…
  </Container>
</main>
```

Inside `AppShell`, which already pads `main`, use `<Container gutter={false}>` or `<AppShell padded={false}>`.

#### Related components

- Instead, see Card: Inside `Card`, `Dialog` or `Sheet`: those set their own padding.
- Instead, see Dialog: Inside `Card`, `Dialog` or `Sheet`: those set their own padding.
- Instead, see Sheet: Inside `Card`, `Dialog` or `Sheet`: those set their own padding.

### CurrencyInput

> A money field. The value is an integer in minor units (ADR-0006) plus an ISO `currency`, never
a float. It uses the **digits-only typing model**: every digit you type shifts in from the
right (typing `1`, `2`, `3` gives `1.23`), separators are ignored, Backspace shifts the last
digit out, and the caret always stays at the end. Pasting is smarter: `12.50` and `12,50` both
paste as 12.50, read against the locale (see CurrencyInput.md). The box is mono and
right-aligned; the currency symbol is part of the text, where the locale puts it, so screen
readers announce it with the amount.

The form receives the integer minor units under `name`.

A money field. The value is an **integer in minor units** plus an ISO 4217 `currency` (ADR-0006), never a float. Built on [Input](../Input/Input.md); the formatting comes from `Intl` through `formatCurrency`-style helpers and `parseCurrencyInput` (see `docs/architecture/utilities.md`). Task: CMP-INP-05.

- Import: `import { CurrencyInput } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/CurrencyInput/CurrencyInput.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/CurrencyInput`): Default, Filled, WithDescription, Required, Invalid, Disabled, ReadOnly, AllowNegative, MaxDigits, Brazilian, ZeroAndThreeDigitCurrencies, Sizes, Controlled

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `currency` | `string` | yes |  | ISO 4217 code of the currency (`'USD'`, `'BRL'`, `'JPY'`). It decides the number of fraction digits (JPY has 0, KWD has 3), the symbol and where the locale places it. |
| `value` | `number \| null` |  |  | The amount in **integer minor units** (ADR-0006): `123456` is `$1,234.56` in USD and `¥123456` in JPY. `null` is an empty field (nothing entered), which is different from `0`. |
| `defaultValue` | `number \| null` |  |  | The initial amount when uncontrolled. Defaults to empty (`null`). |
| `onChange` | `((minorUnits: number \| null) => void)` |  |  | Called with the new amount in minor units, or `null` when the field is emptied. |
| `allowNegative` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Accepts negative amounts. Type `-` anywhere to flip the sign. Default `false`. |
| `maxDigits` | `number` |  | `15` | Most digits the amount may have, fraction digits included (`15` is the maximum, the largest count that is always a safe integer). Typing beyond it is ignored. Default `15`. |
| `name` | `string` |  |  | Name for form submission. The form receives the **integer minor units** (`123456`), or an empty string when the field is empty, never the formatted text. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Helper text under the control. Linked with `aria-describedby`. |
| `errorMessage` | `FieldErrorMessage` |  |  | Error text, shown while the field is invalid and the error is displayed. See `Input`. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  | Text shown while the field is empty. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  |  | Control height: `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (default), `lg` 48px. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the field root. |
| `inputClassName` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the `<input>` element. |
| `inputRef` | `Ref<HTMLInputElement>` |  |  | Ref to the `<input>` element. The `ref` prop points at the field root. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ requiredMark: string; }>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance (`requiredMark`). |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the field root `<div>`. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Visible label. Prefer it: sighted and assistive technology users see the same name. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label (for example a search box with an icon). |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the field. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`
- From `AriaTextFieldProps` (react-aria): `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-autocomplete`, `aria-controls`, `aria-haspopup`, `enterKeyHint`
- From `AriaValidationProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-errormessage`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `DOMRenderProps` (react-aria-components): `render`
- From `FocusableDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `excludeFromTabOrder`
- From `FocusableProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoFocus`
- From `FocusEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBlur`, `onFocus`, `onFocusChange`
- From `InputBase` (@react-types/shared): `isDisabled`, `isReadOnly`
- From `InputDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `form`
- From `KeyboardEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onKeyDown`, `onKeyUp`
- From `RACValidation` (react-aria-components): `validationBehavior`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- From `TextFieldProps` (react-aria-components): `isInvalid`
- From `TextInputDOMEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBeforeInput`, `onCompositionEnd`, `onCompositionStart`, `onCompositionUpdate`, `onCopy`, `onCut`, `onInput`, `onPaste`, `onSelect`
- From `TextInputDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoCorrect`, `spellCheck`
- From `Validation` (@react-types/shared): `isRequired`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`

#### When to use

- Prices, totals, payments, adjustments: anywhere a person types an amount of money.

#### When not to use

- Quantities or measures: `NumberField`.
- Showing an amount (not editing it): `formatCurrency(minorUnits, currency, locale)` from `loui-ds`.

#### Editing model: digits shift in from the right (decision)

Two models were considered:

1. **React Aria `NumberField` with `style: 'currency'`**. Reuses its parsing and stepping, but its editing model is "type a number, format on blur": locale decimal marks must be typed, the caret and text change on blur, and the value is a JS `number` in major units, so every boundary needs `Math.round(x * 100)` and float drift (`0.1 + 0.2`) becomes a bug source. Money in the handoff is also typed without separators.
2. **Digits-only typing** (the handoff model, implemented by `parseCurrencyInput`). Typing `1`, `2`, `3` gives `$1.23`; `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6` gives `$1,234.56`. Separators and symbols are ignored, `Backspace` shifts the last digit out, the caret always stays at the end. The state is an integer from the first keystroke to the form value, so there is no floating point anywhere; the same code serves JPY (0 digits) and KWD (3 digits); no locale decimal mark has to be known to type.

**Decision: digits-only typing**, with a smarter **paste** (below). The trade-off: a person who types `12.5` gets `$1.25`, not `$12.50`. That is the point of the model (type `1250`), the field always shows what it will submit, and paste covers the decimal-writing habit.

#### Behavior

- `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange` are **integer minor units** or `null` (empty, which is not `0`). `onChange` receives `null` when the field is emptied (select all, then `Delete`).
- Display: the currency's own format with the symbol where the locale puts it (`$1,234.56`, `R$ 1.234,56`, `1.234,56 €`, `¥1,234`), mono, tabular, right-aligned. The symbol is part of the text, so screen readers announce it with the amount.
- Caret: always moved to the end after every edit and whenever you click or arrow into the text. A range selection (Ctrl+A) is allowed so you can clear the field.
- `allowNegative`: type `-` anywhere to flip the sign; a lone `-` shows `-$0.00` (negative zero) and the next digit keeps the sign. Without it, minus signs are ignored.
- `maxDigits` (default and maximum 15, the largest count that is always a safe integer): typing beyond it is ignored. Large amounts are exact (`$9,999,999,999,999.99` is `999999999999999`).
- **Paste** reads the text against the locale: `12.50` and `12,50` both paste as 12.50; `1,234.56` in en-US and `1.234,56` in pt-BR are grouped thousands; a lone separator followed by exactly three digits is a thousands group (`1.234` is 1234 in pt-BR but 1.23 in en-US because `.` is the en-US decimal mark); extra fraction digits are rounded half up; symbols and spaces are dropped; text without digits is ignored.
- **Form**: `name` submits the **integer minor units** (`123456`) or an empty string, through a hidden input; it is not sent while the field is disabled. The visible text is never submitted.

#### Props (key ones)

| Prop                                                                                                                | Notes                            |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `currency`                                                                                                          | Required ISO 4217 code.          |
| `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange`                                                                               | `number \| null` in minor units. |
| `allowNegative`, `maxDigits`                                                                                        | See above.                       |
| `label` / `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`                                                                          | One is required.                 |
| `description`, `errorMessage`, `size`, `isRequired`, `isInvalid`, `isDisabled`, `isReadOnly`, `placeholder`, `name` | As in `Input`.                   |
| `inputRef`, `ref`, `className`, `inputClassName`, `messages`                                                        | As in `Input`.                   |

#### Accessibility and keyboard

A text input (`inputmode="numeric"`, or `text` with `allowNegative` so a minus can be typed on mobile) named by the label, described by the description and the error. Digits type, `Backspace` removes the last digit, `-` flips the sign when allowed. There is no live region; the value is announced as typed. The border stays 3:1 in every state (shared Input styling).

#### Content rules

Label the thing being priced ("Price per unit"). The currency symbol is automatic, never part of the label. Errors say how to fix: "Enter a price above zero."

#### Example

```tsx
<CurrencyInput
  label="Price per unit"
  currency="BRL"
  name="price"
  value={priceMinor}
  onChange={setPriceMinor}
/>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see NumberField: Quantities or measures: `NumberField`.
- Renders: Input

### DataTable

> A data table with locale-aware sorting, row selection with a bulk action bar, client-side
pagination, loading and empty states. Built on React Aria `Table` (a real `<table>` with
grid keyboard navigation): the header cell of a sortable column is a press target with
`aria-sort`, and the selection checkboxes are labelled.

Sorting cycles ascending, descending, none, and is stable: rows that compare equal keep the
order you passed. Strings compare with the active locale (accent- and case-insensitive,
natural number order), numbers numerically. The table never reorders rows on its own;
lists are alphabetical by default in this design system, so pass sorted rows or `defaultSort`.

A table of records with locale-aware sorting, row selection with a bulk action bar, clickable rows, client-side pagination, loading and empty states. Built on React Aria `Table`: a real `<table>` with grid keyboard navigation, `aria-sort` on sortable headers and labelled selection checkboxes.

- Import: `import { DataTable } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/DataTable/DataTable.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/DataTable`): Default, AlphabeticalByDefault, Sorting, KeyboardSort, Selection, SelectAllOnPage, KeyboardSelection, SingleSelection, Paginated, SortSelectPaginate, ClickableRows, SelectionAndRowAction, Loading, Empty, CustomEmpty, StickyHeader, LongText, Controlled, PortugueseBrazil

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `readonly DataTableColumn<T>[]` | yes |  | Column definitions, in display order. |
| `rows` | `readonly T[]` | yes |  | The rows, in the order you want them shown until the user sorts. Lists are alphabetical by default in this design system (AGENTS.md rule 5b): sort the rows before passing them, or pass `defaultSort` for a text column. The table never reorders rows on its own. |
| `rowKey` | `string` |  | `'id' as keyof T & string` | Property of a row that holds its unique id. Default `id`. The value is converted to a string. |
| `selectionMode` | `'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'` |  | `'none'` | `none` (default), `single` or `multiple`. Selecting adds a checkbox column. |
| `selectedKeys` | `ReadonlySet<string>` |  |  | Selected row ids (controlled). Selection survives page changes; "select all" applies to the rows of the current page. |
| `defaultSelectedKeys` | `ReadonlySet<string>` |  |  | Selected row ids when uncontrolled. |
| `onSelectionChange` | `(keys: ReadonlySet<string>) => void` |  |  | Called with the new set of selected row ids. |
| `bulkActions` | `(selectedKeys: ReadonlySet<string>, clear: () => void) => ReactNode` |  |  | Content of the bulk action bar, shown while rows are selected: usually small `Button`s. `clear` empties the selection. |
| `sort` | `DataTableSort \| null` |  |  | Current sort (controlled). `null` means no sort. |
| `defaultSort` | `DataTableSort \| null` |  |  | Sort applied first when uncontrolled, for example `{ key: 'customer', direction: 'asc' }`. |
| `onSortChange` | `(sort: DataTableSort \| null) => void` |  |  | Called when the user changes the sort. Header presses cycle ascending, descending, none. |
| `pageSize` | `number \| false` |  | `10` | Rows per page; `false` shows all rows without pagination. Default `10`. Pagination appears only when there is more than one page. |
| `page` | `number` |  |  | Current page, 1-based (controlled). |
| `defaultPage` | `number` |  | `1` | Page shown first when uncontrolled. Default `1`. The page returns to 1 when the sort or the set of rows changes. |
| `onPageChange` | `(page: number) => void` |  |  | Called with the new page. |
| `onRowAction` | `(row: T) => void` |  |  | Called when the user activates a row (click, or Enter on the focused row). Adds a pointer cursor and hover style. |
| `activeKey` | `string` |  |  | Id of the active row (for example the one open in a side sheet). It gets the raised background and the ink bar. |
| `isLoading` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Replaces the rows with skeleton rows and announces "Loading rows". |
| `loadingRowCount` | `number` |  | `5` | Number of skeleton rows while loading. Default `5`. |
| `emptyState` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Content when there are no rows. Default: an `EmptyState` with built-in text. |
| `reserveBulkBarSpace` | `boolean` |  | `true` | Keeps the space of the bulk action bar free while nothing is selected, so the table does not jump down when the first row is selected (fixed positions). Turn off to let the table move up. Default `true`; only applies when `selectionMode` is not `none`. |
| `stickyHeader` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Keeps the header visible while the body scrolls. Set `maxHeight` to scroll inside the table; without it the header sticks to the page scroll. |
| `maxHeight` | `string \| number` |  |  | Maximum height of the table area before it scrolls (a number is px, or any CSS length). |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ selectRow: string; selection: string; selectAll: string; selectedCount: (count: number, formatted: string) => string; clearSelection: string; bulkActions: string; loading: string; emptyTitle: string; emptyDescription: string; }>` |  |  | Per-instance overrides of the built-in messages. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name of the table. Required unless `aria-labelledby` is set. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the table (a visible heading). |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ DataTable: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectRow` | `Select row` | Accessible name of the checkbox that selects one row. React Aria appends the row name (see `getRowLabel`): "Select row ORD-1001". |
| `selection` | `Selection` | Hidden header text of the selection column in `single` mode, where there is no select-all checkbox. |
| `selectAll` | `Select all rows on this page` | Accessible name of the header checkbox. It selects the rows on the current page. |
| `selectedCount(count: number, formatted: string)` | `{formatted} selected` | Visible and announced selection summary. `formatted` is `count` formatted for the locale. |
| `clearSelection` | `Clear selection` | Button of the bulk action bar that clears the selection. |
| `bulkActions` | `Actions for selected rows` | Accessible name of the bulk action bar. |
| `loading` | `Loading rows` | Announced while the table shows loading rows. |
| `emptyTitle` | `No records found` | Title of the default empty state. |
| `emptyDescription` | `Try another filter or search term.` | Description of the default empty state. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-bg`, `--ds-data-table-active-bar-w`, `--ds-data-table-bulk-bar-h`, `--ds-data-table-cell-padding-inline`, `--ds-data-table-col-w`, `--ds-data-table-gap`, `--ds-data-table-header-padding-block`, `--ds-data-table-max-h`, `--ds-data-table-selection-col-w`, `--ds-data-table-sticky-z-index`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-line-subtle`, `--ds-radius-md`, `--ds-row-h`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-surface-raised`, `--ds-surface-row-hover`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-tracking-caption`, `--ds-weight-medium`

#### When to use

- Lists of records the user scans, sorts and acts on: orders, customers, invoices.
- Several columns of comparable data. For one line per record with a menu of actions use `ActionList`.

#### When not to use

- Fewer than three columns, or content that is mostly text: use `ActionList` or a plain list.
- Server-side sorting and paging over very large data sets: control `sort` and `page` yourself and pass the page rows with `pageSize={false}` (virtualization is not provided).
- Layout: this is a data grid, not a layout table.

#### Anatomy

```
div.root
  div[role=group]        bulk action bar (while rows are selected): "N selected", bulkActions, Clear selection
  div.scroll
    table[role=grid]     named by aria-label / aria-labelledby
      thead  th[aria-sort] caption-mono header per column (+ selection checkbox column)
      tbody  tr > td      row height --ds-row-h; active/selected: raised bg + 2px ink bar
  nav                    Pagination (only when there is more than one page)
  span[role=status]      visually hidden live region: "N selected" / "Loading rows"
```

#### Props (key ones)

| Prop                                                         | Type                                          | Default | Notes                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `columns`                                                    | `DataTableColumn<T>[]`                        | -       | `key`, `label`, `width`, `align` (`start`/`end`), `mono`, `muted`, `sortable`, `sortValue`, `render`    |
| `rows`                                                       | `T[]`                                         | -       | Shown in the order given until the user sorts                                                           |
| `rowKey`                                                     | `keyof T`                                     | `id`    | Unique id property; converted to a string                                                               |
| `aria-label`                                                 | `string`                                      | -       | Required (or `aria-labelledby`)                                                                         |
| `selectionMode`                                              | `none \| single \| multiple`                  | `none`  | Adds a checkbox column                                                                                  |
| `selectedKeys` / `defaultSelectedKeys` / `onSelectionChange` | `ReadonlySet<string>`                         |         | Controlled / uncontrolled. Selection survives page changes                                              |
| `bulkActions`                                                | `(keys, clear) => ReactNode`                  |         | Content of the bar shown while rows are selected                                                        |
| `sort` / `defaultSort` / `onSortChange`                      | `{ key, direction: 'asc' \| 'desc' } \| null` | `null`  | Controlled / uncontrolled sort                                                                          |
| `pageSize`                                                   | `number \| false`                             | `10`    | `false` disables pagination                                                                             |
| `page` / `defaultPage` / `onPageChange`                      | `number`                                      | `1`     | Controlled / uncontrolled page                                                                          |
| `onRowAction`                                                | `(row) => void`                               |         | Row click or Enter. Adds hover style and pointer cursor                                                 |
| `activeKey`                                                  | `string`                                      |         | Row open elsewhere (raised background + ink bar)                                                        |
| `isLoading`                                                  | `boolean`                                     | `false` | Skeleton rows (`loadingRowCount`, default 5) and a live "Loading rows"                                  |
| `emptyState`                                                 | `ReactNode`                                   |         | Default: `EmptyState` with built-in text                                                                |
| `reserveBulkBarSpace`                                        | `boolean`                                     | `true`  | Keeps the bulk bar space free so the table does not jump when the first row is selected                 |
| `stickyHeader`, `maxHeight`                                  | `boolean`, `number \| string`                 |         | With `maxHeight` the body scrolls and the header stays; without it the header sticks to the page scroll |
| `messages`                                                   | `Partial<messages>`                           |         | Per-instance text overrides                                                                             |

#### Sorting

- Pressing a sortable header cycles **ascending, descending, none**. `aria-sort` is `ascending`, `descending` or `none` on the header cell.
- Strings use `compareText` for the active locale: accent- and case-insensitive, natural number order (`Item 2` before `Item 10`). Numbers, booleans and dates compare numerically; numbers come before strings.
- The sort is **stable in both directions**: equal rows keep the order you passed (descending is not a reversed array). Empty values (`null`, `undefined`, `NaN`, invalid dates) always come last.
- Sorting covers all rows, not just the current page; the page returns to 1 when the sort or the set of rows changes (a new array with the same row ids does not reset the page).
- Use `sortValue` when the displayed text differs from the value to sort by, `sortable: false` for columns that are not a property of the row.

##### Alphabetical by default

Lists are alphabetical by default in this design system (AGENTS.md rule 5b; exceptions: tasks by urgency, dated records newest first). The table does not reorder rows on its own. Either pass rows already ordered, or set `defaultSort={{ key: 'customer', direction: 'asc' }}` (see the `AlphabeticalByDefault` story).

#### Selection

- Checkboxes are named "Select row {row header text}" and "Select all rows on this page"; the row header is the column marked `isRowHeader` (default: the first column), so choose the most descriptive one.
- "Select all" applies to the rows on the current page. Selection of other pages is kept. `bulkActions` receives only ids that still exist in `rows`.
- The bulk bar shows "N selected" (plural-aware) and a "Clear selection" button. A visually hidden polite `status` announces the count as it changes.
- `single` mode shows a checkbox per row but no select-all.

#### Accessibility

- Grid keyboard model from React Aria: `Tab` enters the table (first row), arrow keys move between cells, rows and the header (Arrow Up from the first row), `Enter` or `Space` on a sortable header sorts, `Space` on a selection checkbox toggles, `Enter` on a row runs `onRowAction`, `Tab` leaves the table.
- Sortable headers expose `aria-sort`; the sort icon is decorative. Active sorted headers also use a stronger color, never color alone.
- Selection state is `aria-selected` on rows and the checked state of the checkboxes; the count is text.
- While loading the root has `aria-busy`, skeleton rows are not selectable and the first cell of each carries visually hidden "Loading rows".
- Forced colors: selected and active rows keep the bar (system `Highlight`); focus rings are outlines.
- Not provided: `aria-rowcount`/`aria-rowindex` for the rows of other pages (React Aria derives them from the rendered page). Pagination announces the range ("11–20 of 42").

#### Content rules

- Column labels in sentence case; CSS applies the uppercase mono caption style.
- Bulk actions are verb + object ("Archive orders"); destructive ones still confirm in a dialog.
- Empty text says what happened and what to do ("No records found. Try another filter or search term.").

#### Examples

```tsx
<DataTable
  aria-label="Orders"
  rows={orders}
  rowKey="id"
  defaultSort={{ key: 'customer', direction: 'asc' }}
  selectionMode="multiple"
  columns={[
    { key: 'id', label: 'Order', width: '120px', mono: true, muted: true },
    { key: 'customer', label: 'Customer', isRowHeader: true },
    {
      key: 'status',
      label: 'Status',
      width: '120px',
      render: (r) => <Badge tone="success">{r.status}</Badge>,
    },
    {
      key: 'total',
      label: 'Total',
      width: '120px',
      align: 'end',
      mono: true,
      render: (r) => formatCurrency(r.total, 'USD', locale),
    },
  ]}
  bulkActions={(keys, clear) => (
    <Button
      size="sm"
      onPress={() => {
        archive(keys);
        clear();
      }}
    >
      Archive orders
    </Button>
  )}
  onRowAction={(row) => openOrder(row.id)}
/>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see ActionList: Fewer than three columns, or content that is mostly text: use `ActionList` or a plain list.
- Renders: Button, Checkbox, EmptyState, Icon, Pagination, Skeleton, VisuallyHidden

### DatePicker

> A date field with a calendar popover (React Aria `DatePicker`). The value is a
`YYYY-MM-DD` string (no time zone, so the day never shifts); the typed segments, the
placeholder, month and weekday names and the first day of the week all follow the
`DSProvider` locale. Type the date (arrows or digits per segment) or open the calendar;
"Today" and "Clear" sit under the grid.

The form receives the ISO date under `name`. Range selection is not part of this component.

`DatePicker` is a date field (typed segments) with a calendar popover and "Today" / "Clear" buttons. `Calendar` is the standalone month grid. Built on React Aria `DatePicker`, `DateInput`, `DateSegment`, `Calendar`, `CalendarGrid`, `CalendarCell`, `Popover`. Task: CMP-INP-02.

- Import: `import { DatePicker } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/DatePicker/DatePicker.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/DatePicker`): Default, CalendarKeyboard, Open, PickDate, EscapeRestoresFocus, WithValue, MinAndMax, Required, Invalid, Disabled, ReadOnly, Brazilian, Sizes, StandaloneCalendar

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string \| null` |  |  | The date as `YYYY-MM-DD` (no time zone), or `null` for none. Pair with `onChange`. |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| null` |  |  | The initial date when uncontrolled. |
| `onChange` | `((value: string \| null) => void)` |  |  | Called with the new date as `YYYY-MM-DD` once every segment is filled, or `null` from the Clear button. An incomplete date is not reported. |
| `min` | `string` |  |  | Earliest selectable date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Typing an earlier date makes the field invalid. |
| `max` | `string` |  |  | Latest selectable date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Helper text under the control. Linked with `aria-describedby`. |
| `errorMessage` | `FieldErrorMessage` |  |  | Error text, shown while the field is invalid and the error is displayed. See `Input`. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  | `'md'` | Control height: `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (default), `lg` 48px. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the field root. |
| `popoverClassName` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the popover that holds the calendar. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ today: string; clear: string; openCalendar: string; } & { requiredMark: string; } & Partial<{ previousMonth: string; nextMonth: string; }>>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance: `today`, `clear`, `openCalendar`, `previousMonth`, `nextMonth`, `requiredMark`. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the field root `<div>`. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Visible label. Prefer it: sighted and assistive technology users see the same name. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label (for example a search box with an icon). |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the field. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaDatePickerProps` (react-aria): `autoComplete`
- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`
- From `DatePickerBase` (react-stately): `firstDayOfWeek`, `pageBehavior`
- From `DatePickerStateOptions` (react-stately): `shouldCloseOnSelect`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `FocusableProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoFocus`
- From `FocusEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBlur`, `onFocus`, `onFocusChange`
- From `InputBase` (@react-types/shared): `isDisabled`, `isReadOnly`
- From `InputDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `form`, `name`
- From `KeyboardEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onKeyDown`, `onKeyUp`
- From `OverlayTriggerProps` (react-stately): `isOpen`, `onOpenChange`
- From `RACValidation` (react-aria-components): `validationBehavior`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- From `Validation` (@react-types/shared): `isInvalid`, `isRequired`, `validate`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ DatePicker: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `today` | `Today` | Footer button that picks today's date. |
| `clear` | `Clear` | Footer button that empties the field. |
| `openCalendar` | `Open calendar` | Accessible name of the button that opens the calendar. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-calendar-cell-size`, `--ds-calendar-today-ring-width`, `--ds-calendar-weekday-height`, `--ds-field-control-padding-inline`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-lg`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-surface-raised`, `--ds-target-min`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-text-inverse`, `--ds-weight-medium`, `--ds-weight-semibold`, `--ds-z-dropdown`

#### When to use

- A single calendar date: delivery, due date, birthday.
- `Calendar` alone for inline planners and for composing your own picker.

#### When not to use

- A date range: not supported yet (range picker is P2).
- A time of day or a timestamp: the value has no time and no time zone.
- Dates years away from now: typing the segments is faster than the grid.

#### Value contract

`value`, `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `min` and `max` are **ISO strings `YYYY-MM-DD`** (the `ISODate` type of `src/utils/date`), never `Date`. Conversion to React Aria's `CalendarDate` happens inside the component (`@internationalized/date`, see below), so the day cannot shift with the viewer's time zone. Invalid strings are treated as "no date". `onChange` receives a string only once every segment is filled, or `null` from the Clear button; an incomplete date is not reported. The form receives the ISO string under `name`.

#### Props (key ones)

| Prop                                                                                                 | Notes                                                                                                                           |
