- From `PossibleLinkDOMRenderProps` (react-aria-components): `render`
- From `PressEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onClick`, `onPress`, `onPressChange`, `onPressEnd`, `onPressStart`, `onPressUp`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `variant`: `inline`, `standalone`

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Link: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opensInNewTab` | `(opens in a new tab)` |  |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-space-1`

#### When to use

- To go somewhere: another route, a section (`#id`), a document or an external site.
- Inside running text (`inline`), or as a quiet navigation line such as "View all orders" (`standalone`).

#### When not to use

- To run an action in place (save, delete, open a dialog): use `Button`.
- For a styled call to action that happens to navigate: still a link semantically, but use a `Button` with `href` when it is the primary action of the screen (planned with the button-as-link variant).

#### Variants

| Variant      | At rest   | Hover and keyboard focus | Use                                                                      |
| ------------ | --------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `inline`     | underline | thicker underline        | Links inside sentences. Default.                                         |
| `standalone` | none      | underline                | Navigation lists, "View all" lines. Only where context makes it obvious. |

Color alone never identifies a link (WCAG 1.4.1), so inline links are always underlined. The accent color (`--ds-accent`) is reserved for focus, selection and links.

#### Routing

Wrap the app once: `<DSProvider navigate={router.push} useHref={router.resolve}>`. Links with a relative `href` then navigate without a page reload; modified clicks (Ctrl/Cmd, middle button) and `target="_blank"` keep the browser behavior.

#### Accessibility

- Real `<a href>`: opens in a new tab with the context menu, can be copied, works without JavaScript.
- Keys: `Tab` focuses, `Enter` follows. (`Space` does not activate a link, by design.)
- Focus: 3px accent ring through `data-focus-visible`; forced-colors mode repaints the transparent outline and system link colors apply.
- Links that open a new tab: the name ends with "(opens in a new tab)" for screen readers (hidden text from the `Link` messages) and a decorative icon shows it visually. `rel="noopener noreferrer"` is added automatically.
- Contrast: accent `#8AB4FF` on the dark surfaces is well above 4.5:1.
- Target size: inline links in text are exempt from WCAG 2.5.8; standalone links should sit in a 24px-high row.
- Reduced motion: hover changes decoration thickness only, no animation.

#### Content rules

- Link text describes the destination or action and makes sense out of context: "Pricing details", "Download invoice". Never "click here" or "read more".
- Sentence case, no trailing punctuation inside the link, no emoji.
- Do not repeat the word "link". The role is announced.

#### Examples

```tsx
<p>
  Read the <Link href="/pricing">pricing details</Link> before you change a plan.
</p>

<Link variant="standalone" href="/orders">View all orders</Link>

<Link href="https://example.com/docs" target="_blank">Documentation</Link>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Button: To run an action in place (save, delete, open a dialog): use `Button`.
- Renders: Icon, VisuallyHidden
- Used by: Citation, SourceList

### MatrixGrid

> A matrix of toggle cells: rows by columns, each cell linking or unlinking one row with one
column. It is an ARIA `grid` with roving focus: the grid is one tab stop, the arrow keys move
between cells (`Home` / `End` within a row, `Ctrl+Home` / `Ctrl+End` to the first / last
cell), and `Space` or `Enter` toggles. Arrow keys follow the reading direction.

Each cell is a button named "{row} · {column}: linked" / "not linked" (messages). The grid
scrolls horizontally inside a labelled, focusable region.

Import it from `loui-ds/patterns`.

A rows-by-columns matrix of toggle cells, where each cell links or unlinks one row with one column (for example which colors a product comes in). It is an ARIA `grid` with roving focus and full arrow-key navigation. Import it from `loui-ds/patterns`.

- Handoff source: `components/erp/MatrixGrid.jsx` (TODO `CMP-PAT-11`).

- Import: `import { MatrixGrid } from 'loui-ds/patterns';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/patterns/MatrixGrid/MatrixGrid.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Patterns/MatrixGrid`): Default, WithCountAndHint, CheckContrast, WithoutColors, ManyColumns, LongLabels, Empty, KeyboardNavigation, Portuguese, RightToLeft, Focused

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-label` | `string` | yes |  | Accessible name of the grid ("Product colors"). The scroll region around it is named from it too. |
| `rows` | `readonly MatrixGridRow[]` | yes |  | The rows, in display order. Sort them yourself (alphabetically by default). |
| `columns` | `readonly MatrixGridColumn[]` | yes |  | The columns, in display order. |
| `isLinked` | `(rowId: string, columnId: string) => boolean` | yes |  | Whether a row and a column are linked. Called for every cell on each render; keep it cheap. |
| `onToggle` | `(rowId: string, columnId: string) => void` | yes |  | Called with the row and column ids when the user toggles a cell. Update your state in it. |
| `cornerLabel` | `string` |  |  | Caption of the first (row header) column. Without it a visually hidden "Row" is used. |
| `countLabel` | `string` |  |  | Adds a last column with the number of linked cells per row; this is its header ("Linked"). |
| `hint` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Help text under the grid, linked to it with `aria-describedby`. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ cell: (row: string, column: string, linked: boolean) => string; scrollRegion: (name: string) => string; rowHeader: string; }>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ MatrixGrid: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cell(row: string, column: string, linked: boolean)` | `{row} · {column}: not linked` | Accessible name of a toggle cell: the row, the column and the state of the link. |
| `scrollRegion(name: string)` | `{name}, scrollable` | Accessible name of the focusable scroll region around the grid. `name` is the grid's name. |
| `rowHeader` | `Row` | Hidden header text of the first column when no `cornerLabel` is given. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-fs-meta`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-lh-meta`, `--ds-line`, `--ds-line-control`, `--ds-line-subtle`, `--ds-matrix-grid-cell-size`, `--ds-matrix-grid-color`, `--ds-matrix-grid-column-header-padding-inline`, `--ds-matrix-grid-column-width`, `--ds-matrix-grid-columns`, `--ds-matrix-grid-count-width`, `--ds-matrix-grid-label-width`, `--ds-matrix-grid-padding-inline`, `--ds-matrix-grid-row-header-gap`, `--ds-matrix-grid-row-min-height`, `--ds-radius-lg`, `--ds-radius-md`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-surface`, `--ds-surface-row-hover`, `--ds-swatch-ring`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-text-inverse`, `--ds-tracking-caption`, `--ds-weight-medium`

#### When to use

- Editing many-to-many relations where seeing the whole matrix helps (items by options, users by roles, products by regions).
- When every cell is a quick on/off decision.

#### When not to use

- Reading or sorting data: use a table (`DataTable`).
- One list of independent switches: use `CheckboxGroup` or `Switch`.
- Very large matrices (hundreds of rows): this component renders every cell.

#### Anatomy

```
div.root
  div[role=region] aria-label="… scrollable" tabindex=0      (horizontal scroll)
    div[role=grid] aria-label aria-describedby=hint
      div[role=row]
        columnheader (corner caption) · columnheader (swatch + label) × N · columnheader (count)
      div[role=row] × rows
        rowheader (label + meta) · gridcell > button "{row} · {column}: linked" × N · gridcell (count)
  p.hint
```

#### Accessibility

- Semantics: `region` (focusable scroll container) > `grid` > `row` > `columnheader` / `rowheader` / `gridcell`. Each cell holds a native button named "{row} · {column}: linked" or "not linked" (messages, `en` and `pt-BR`); the state is in the name, so there is no separate `aria-pressed`.
- Keyboard: the grid is one tab stop (roving tabindex; the scroll region is the stop before it). `←` `→` `↑` `↓` move one cell (horizontal arrows follow the reading direction and stop at the edges); `Home` / `End` go to the first / last cell of the row; `Ctrl+Home` / `Ctrl+End` to the first / last cell of the grid; `Space` and `Enter` toggle.
- Linked state is not color alone: linked cells are solid with a check, unlinked cells are dashed with a plus; the name says it too.
- The check color is chosen with `readableTextOn` (WCAG relative luminance) on the column color, and the choice is tested at 3:1 for a set of colors.
- Targets are 40x40px (the minimum is 24px). Unlinked cell borders use `--ds-line-control` (3:1).
- Motion: the hover scale (1.06) exists only inside `@media (hover: hover) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`.
- Forced colors: borders use `ButtonText`, linked cells `Highlight`.

#### Content rules

- Row and column labels are short nouns in sentence case; they are read in every cell name, so keep them unique within their axis.
- `countLabel` names what is counted ("Linked", "Colors").

#### Examples

```tsx
import { MatrixGrid } from 'loui-ds/patterns';

<MatrixGrid
  aria-label="Product colors"
  cornerLabel="Product"
  countLabel="Linked"
  rows={products}
  columns={[{ id: 'navy', label: 'Navy', color: '#1f3a93' }]}
  isLinked={(productId, colorId) => links.has(`${productId}:${colorId}`)}
  onToggle={toggleLink}
  hint="Select a cell to link or unlink a color."
/>;
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see DataTable: Reading or sorting data: use a table (`DataTable`).
- Instead, see CheckboxGroup: One list of independent switches: use `CheckboxGroup` or `Switch`.
- Instead, see Switch: One list of independent switches: use `CheckboxGroup` or `Switch`.
- Renders: Icon, Swatch, VisuallyHidden

### Menu

> A menu of commands that opens from a trigger, built on React Aria `MenuTrigger`, `Popover`
and `Menu`.

Keys: the trigger opens it with Enter, Space or Arrow Down (focus goes to the first item;
Arrow Up focuses the last); Arrow Up/Down, Home/End and typeahead move; Enter or Space
activates; Escape closes and focus returns to the trigger. Selection modes
(`selectionMode="single"` or `"multiple"`) turn items into radio or checkbox items.

A menu of commands that opens from a trigger. Built on React Aria `MenuTrigger`, `Popover` and `Menu`. Exports `Menu`, `MenuItem`, `MenuSection`, `MenuSeparator`, `SubMenu` and `MoreActionsMenu`.

- Handoff source: `components/navigation/Menu` (CMP-NAV-02).

- Import: `import { Menu } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Menu/Menu.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Menu`): Default, EscapeRestoresFocus, TypeaheadAndHomeEnd, Open, CheckboxItems, RadioItems, WithSections, WithSubmenu, LongLabels, MoreActions

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>>` | yes |  | The element that opens the menu: a `Button` or `IconButton`. It receives `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded` and names the menu (`aria-labelledby`), so give it a clear name. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | yes |  | `MenuItem`, `MenuSection`, `MenuSeparator` and `SubMenu` elements. |
| `placement` | `'bottom' \| 'bottom left' \| 'bottom right' \| 'bottom start' \| 'bottom end' \| 'top' \| 'top left' \| 'top right' \| 'top start' \| 'top end' \| 'left' \| 'left top' \| 'left bottom' \| 'start' \| 'start top' \| 'start bottom' \| 'right' \| 'right top' \| 'right bottom' \| 'end' \| 'end top' \| 'end bottom'` |  | `'bottom start'` | Side and alignment relative to the trigger. Default `bottom start`. Flips on collision. |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` |  |  | Controlled open state. Pair with `onOpenChange`. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  |  | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(isOpen: boolean) => void` |  |  | Called when the menu opens or closes. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the menu list. |
| `popoverClassName` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the popover that holds the menu. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the menu list element. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`
- From `AriaMenuProps` (react-aria): `escapeKeyBehavior`
- From `CollectionBase` (@react-types/shared): `disabledKeys`, `items`
- From `CollectionProps` (react-aria-components): `dependencies`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `MenuProps` (react-aria): `autoFocus`, `onAction`, `onClose`, `shouldFocusWrap`
- From `MenuProps` (react-aria-components): `renderEmptyState`, `shouldCloseOnSelect`
- From `MultipleSelection` (@react-types/shared): `defaultSelectedKeys`, `disallowEmptySelection`, `onSelectionChange`, `selectedKeys`, `selectionMode`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Menu: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `moreActions` | `More actions` | Name of the overflow button of `MoreActionsMenu`. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-danger`, `--ds-danger-soft-hover`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-item-h`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-menu-indicator-size`, `--ds-menu-max-width`, `--ds-menu-min-width`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-lg`, `--ds-radius-pill`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-select-popover-max-height`, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-4`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-surface-raised`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-tracking-caption`

#### When to use

- Row, card or toolbar actions that do not deserve their own button.
- View options with check or radio items (columns shown, sort order, density).

#### When not to use

- Choosing a value for a field: use `Select` or `Combobox`.
- Content the user types into or operates (filters, forms): use `Popover`.
- Navigation between pages: use `Tabs`, `Sidebar` or `Breadcrumb`.
- The only way to reach an important action: keep primary actions visible.

#### Anatomy

```
MenuTrigger
  trigger            Button | IconButton    aria-haspopup=true, aria-expanded
  Popover            raised surface, radius lg, overlay shadow, z popover
    Menu             role=menu, named by the trigger (aria-labelledby)
      MenuItem       role=menuitem | menuitemcheckbox | menuitemradio, height --ds-item-h
        indicator    check / dot (selectable menus)
        label
        shortcut     mono hint, optional
        chevron      when it opens a SubMenu
      MenuSection    role=group, caption optional (mono uppercase)
      MenuSeparator  1px line
```

#### Accessibility

Keyboard contract (AGENTS.md section 8):

| Key                                     | Behavior                                                        |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Enter`, `Space`, `ArrowDown` (trigger) | Opens the menu and focuses the first item                       |
| `ArrowUp` (trigger)                     | Opens the menu and focuses the last item                        |
| `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown`                 | Move between items; disabled items are skipped                  |
| `Home` / `End`                          | First / last item                                               |
| Typing                                  | Typeahead: focus moves to the item whose label starts with it   |
| `Enter` / `Space`                       | Activates the item (checkbox and radio items toggle) and closes |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft`              | Open / close a submenu (mirrored in right-to-left)              |
| `Escape`                                | Closes one level; focus returns to the trigger                  |

- Items are real `menuitem`, `menuitemcheckbox` or `menuitemradio` elements with `aria-checked`; the handoff used `tabIndex=0` divs with no keyboard activation.
- Danger is red text plus the item's own label ("Delete order"); the colour is never the only signal. `tone="danger"` does not confirm: open a `ConfirmDialog` from `onAction`.
- The shortcut hint is visual; bind the key yourself. It uses `--ds-text-2` so the hint stays legible next to the label.
- Focus is shown with the accent ring; forced colors use a `Highlight` outline.
- Layer: `--ds-z-popover` (see Dialog doc, "Layers", for menus opened inside a Dialog or Sheet).
- The `MoreActionsMenu` trigger has a tooltip that repeats its name.

#### Content rules

- Items are a verb plus object in sentence case ("Duplicate order"). End with an ellipsis only when the item opens something that needs more input ("Move to…").
- Order: most common first, destructive last, separated by a `MenuSeparator`.

#### Examples

```tsx
<MoreActionsMenu onAction={(key) => run(String(key))}>
  <MenuItem id="edit" shortcut="Ctrl+E">Edit order</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem id="duplicate">Duplicate order</MenuItem>
  <MenuSeparator />
  <MenuItem id="delete" tone="danger">Delete order</MenuItem>
</MoreActionsMenu>

<Menu trigger={<Button>View</Button>} selectionMode="multiple" defaultSelectedKeys={['id']}>
  <MenuItem id="id">Show ID</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem id="status">Show status</MenuItem>
</Menu>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Select: Choosing a value for a field: use `Select` or `Combobox`.
- Instead, see Combobox: Choosing a value for a field: use `Select` or `Combobox`.
- Instead, see Popover: Content the user types into or operates (filters, forms): use `Popover`.
- Instead, see Tabs: Navigation between pages: use `Tabs`, `Sidebar` or `Breadcrumb`.
- Instead, see Sidebar: Navigation between pages: use `Tabs`, `Sidebar` or `Breadcrumb`.
- Instead, see Breadcrumb: Navigation between pages: use `Tabs`, `Sidebar` or `Breadcrumb`.
- Renders: Icon, IconButton

### MenuItem

> One command. Inside a menu with `selectionMode` it becomes a checkbox or radio item and shows
its selected state with a check or a dot. Disabled items are dimmed and skipped by keyboard
navigation.

A menu of commands that opens from a trigger. Built on React Aria `MenuTrigger`, `Popover` and `Menu`. Exports `Menu`, `MenuItem`, `MenuSection`, `MenuSeparator`, `SubMenu` and `MoreActionsMenu`.

### MenuSection

> A group of items with an optional caption. Give a section its own `selectionMode` to make a
radio group or a set of checkbox items inside a menu that also holds plain commands.

A menu of commands that opens from a trigger. Built on React Aria `MenuTrigger`, `Popover` and `Menu`. Exports `Menu`, `MenuItem`, `MenuSection`, `MenuSeparator`, `SubMenu` and `MoreActionsMenu`.

- Handoff source: `components/navigation/Menu` (CMP-NAV-02).

- Import: `import { MenuSection } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Menu/Menu.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Menu`): Default, EscapeRestoresFocus, TypeaheadAndHomeEnd, Open, CheckboxItems, RadioItems, WithSections, WithSubmenu, LongLabels, MoreActions

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | yes |  | `MenuItem` elements. |
| `title` | `string` |  |  | Caption of the group, announced as its name. Mono uppercase by CSS. Omit it for an unnamed group. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |  |

##### Inherited props

- From `CollectionBase` (@react-types/shared): `items`
- From `CollectionProps` (react-aria-components): `dependencies`
- From `MenuProps` (react-aria-components): `shouldCloseOnSelect`
- From `MultipleSelection` (@react-types/shared): `defaultSelectedKeys`, `disallowEmptySelection`, `onSelectionChange`, `selectedKeys`, `selectionMode`
- From `SectionProps` (react-aria-components): `id`, `value`
- From `SectionProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-label`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-danger`, `--ds-danger-soft-hover`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-item-h`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-menu-indicator-size`, `--ds-menu-max-width`, `--ds-menu-min-width`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-lg`, `--ds-radius-pill`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-select-popover-max-height`, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-4`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-surface-raised`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-tracking-caption`

#### When to use

- Row, card or toolbar actions that do not deserve their own button.
- View options with check or radio items (columns shown, sort order, density).

#### When not to use

- Choosing a value for a field: use `Select` or `Combobox`.
- Content the user types into or operates (filters, forms): use `Popover`.
- Navigation between pages: use `Tabs`, `Sidebar` or `Breadcrumb`.
- The only way to reach an important action: keep primary actions visible.

#### Anatomy

```
MenuTrigger
  trigger            Button | IconButton    aria-haspopup=true, aria-expanded
  Popover            raised surface, radius lg, overlay shadow, z popover
    Menu             role=menu, named by the trigger (aria-labelledby)
      MenuItem       role=menuitem | menuitemcheckbox | menuitemradio, height --ds-item-h
        indicator    check / dot (selectable menus)
        label
        shortcut     mono hint, optional
        chevron      when it opens a SubMenu
      MenuSection    role=group, caption optional (mono uppercase)
      MenuSeparator  1px line
```

#### Accessibility

Keyboard contract (AGENTS.md section 8):

| Key                                     | Behavior                                                        |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Enter`, `Space`, `ArrowDown` (trigger) | Opens the menu and focuses the first item                       |
| `ArrowUp` (trigger)                     | Opens the menu and focuses the last item                        |
| `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown`                 | Move between items; disabled items are skipped                  |
| `Home` / `End`                          | First / last item                                               |
| Typing                                  | Typeahead: focus moves to the item whose label starts with it   |
| `Enter` / `Space`                       | Activates the item (checkbox and radio items toggle) and closes |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft`              | Open / close a submenu (mirrored in right-to-left)              |
| `Escape`                                | Closes one level; focus returns to the trigger                  |

- Items are real `menuitem`, `menuitemcheckbox` or `menuitemradio` elements with `aria-checked`; the handoff used `tabIndex=0` divs with no keyboard activation.
- Danger is red text plus the item's own label ("Delete order"); the colour is never the only signal. `tone="danger"` does not confirm: open a `ConfirmDialog` from `onAction`.
- The shortcut hint is visual; bind the key yourself. It uses `--ds-text-2` so the hint stays legible next to the label.
- Focus is shown with the accent ring; forced colors use a `Highlight` outline.
- Layer: `--ds-z-popover` (see Dialog doc, "Layers", for menus opened inside a Dialog or Sheet).
- The `MoreActionsMenu` trigger has a tooltip that repeats its name.

#### Content rules

- Items are a verb plus object in sentence case ("Duplicate order"). End with an ellipsis only when the item opens something that needs more input ("Move to…").
- Order: most common first, destructive last, separated by a `MenuSeparator`.

#### Examples

```tsx
<MoreActionsMenu onAction={(key) => run(String(key))}>
  <MenuItem id="edit" shortcut="Ctrl+E">Edit order</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem id="duplicate">Duplicate order</MenuItem>
  <MenuSeparator />
  <MenuItem id="delete" tone="danger">Delete order</MenuItem>
</MoreActionsMenu>

<Menu trigger={<Button>View</Button>} selectionMode="multiple" defaultSelectedKeys={['id']}>
  <MenuItem id="id">Show ID</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem id="status">Show status</MenuItem>
</Menu>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Select: Choosing a value for a field: use `Select` or `Combobox`.
- Instead, see Combobox: Choosing a value for a field: use `Select` or `Combobox`.
- Instead, see Popover: Content the user types into or operates (filters, forms): use `Popover`.
- Instead, see Tabs: Navigation between pages: use `Tabs`, `Sidebar` or `Breadcrumb`.
- Instead, see Sidebar: Navigation between pages: use `Tabs`, `Sidebar` or `Breadcrumb`.
- Instead, see Breadcrumb: Navigation between pages: use `Tabs`, `Sidebar` or `Breadcrumb`.
- Renders: Icon, IconButton

### MenuSeparator

> A 1px line between groups of items.

A menu of commands that opens from a trigger. Built on React Aria `MenuTrigger`, `Popover` and `Menu`. Exports `Menu`, `MenuItem`, `MenuSection`, `MenuSeparator`, `SubMenu` and `MoreActionsMenu`.

- Handoff source: `components/navigation/Menu` (CMP-NAV-02).

### Meter

> A bar that shows a quantity within a known range (disk used, quota, score), as opposed to
progress of a task. Built on React Aria `Meter` (`role="meter"`).

A thin bar (4 px) with a label and a value in mono type. `Progress` shows the progress of a task, determinate or indeterminate (React Aria `ProgressBar`, `role="progressbar"`). `Meter` shows a quantity within a range (React Aria `Meter`, `role="meter"`) and shares the same look.

- Import: `import { Meter } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Progress/Progress.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Progress`): Default, WithoutLabel, ShowValue, Empty, Complete, Warning, Danger, Indeterminate, AllTones, AsMeter, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Visible label, wired to the bar with `aria-labelledby`. Required unless you set `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`: a bar without a name is an accessibility bug (React Aria warns in development). |
| `meta` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Text on the right of the label, in mono type: "6.2 / 10 GB". It is visual only. If it says more than the percentage, also pass `valueLabel` so screen readers hear the same thing. |
| `showValue` | `boolean` |  |  | Shows the formatted percentage (`62%`, from `Intl` with the active locale) as `meta` when `meta` is not given. |
| `tone` | `'accent' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` |  | `'accent'` | Color of the fill. Color is never the only signal: pair it with a label or `meta`. Default `accent`. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  |  |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `ProgressBarBaseProps` (react-aria): `formatOptions`, `maxValue`, `minValue`, `value`, `valueLabel`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `tone`: `accent`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-danger`, `--ds-duration-progress`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-progress-height`, `--ds-progress-indeterminate-duration`, `--ds-progress-indeterminate-width`, `--ds-radius-pill`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-success`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-warning`

#### When to use

- `Progress`: an upload, an import, a multi-step job. Use indeterminate when the amount is unknown.
- `Meter`: disk used, quota consumed, a score. The value is a measurement, not a task that will finish.

#### When not to use

- Waiting with no known structure and no label: use `Spinner`.
- Content that is loading: use `Skeleton`.

#### Anatomy

```
div[role=progressbar|meter]
  div.header      Label (left) · meta (right, mono)
  div.track       4px, pill
    div.fill      width = percentage (or a sweeping segment when indeterminate)
```

#### Accessibility

- The bar is named by the visible label (`aria-labelledby`) or `aria-label`; React Aria warns in development when a bar has neither.
- `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax` are set, and `aria-valuetext` is the percentage formatted with `Intl` for the active locale ("62%", "62,5%" in pt-BR). If you show "6.2 / 10 GB", set `valueLabel="6.2 of 10 GB"` so screen readers hear the same thing.
- An indeterminate bar has no `aria-valuenow`, so assistive technology reports it as busy without a number.
- Progress does not announce changes by itself. For long tasks, announce milestones and completion in a live region (for example with a `Toast`).
- Color is not the only signal: the label and the value text carry the meaning. The fill is 4 px high but the track and fill are a graphic that keeps at least 3:1 against the surface; the track is a neutral surface step.
- **Reduced motion:** the width change has no transition and the indeterminate sweep becomes a static segment centered in the track. **Forced colors:** the track gets a border and the fill uses the text color.

#### Content rules

- Labels are nouns or short phrases in sentence case ("Storage", "Importing orders").
- Put units and ratios in `meta`, in the formatted form of the active locale.

#### Examples

```tsx
<Progress value={62} label="Storage" meta="6.2 / 10 GB" valueLabel="6.2 of 10 GB" />
<Progress isIndeterminate label="Importing orders" />
<Meter value={82} tone="warning" label="Quota" showValue />
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Spinner: Waiting with no known structure and no label: use `Spinner`.
- Instead, see Skeleton: Content that is loading: use `Skeleton`.

### MoreActionsMenu

> The common "more actions" menu: an icon button with three dots whose name comes from the
message catalog ("More actions"), opening a `Menu`. Use it for the row or card actions that
do not deserve their own button.

A menu of commands that opens from a trigger. Built on React Aria `MenuTrigger`, `Popover` and `Menu`. Exports `Menu`, `MenuItem`, `MenuSection`, `MenuSeparator`, `SubMenu` and `MoreActionsMenu`.

- Handoff source: `components/navigation/Menu` (CMP-NAV-02).

- Import: `import { MoreActionsMenu } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Menu/Menu.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Menu`): Default, EscapeRestoresFocus, TypeaheadAndHomeEnd, Open, CheckboxItems, RadioItems, WithSections, WithSubmenu, LongLabels, MoreActions

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | yes |  | `MenuItem`, `MenuSection`, `MenuSeparator` and `SubMenu` elements. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  | `'md'` | Size of the trigger button. Default `md`. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ moreActions: string; }>` |  |  | Per-instance overrides of the built-in messages. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the menu list. |
| `placement` | `'bottom' \| 'bottom left' \| 'bottom right' \| 'bottom start' \| 'bottom end' \| 'top' \| 'top left' \| 'top right' \| 'top start' \| 'top end' \| 'left' \| 'left top' \| 'left bottom' \| 'start' \| 'start top' \| 'start bottom' \| 'right' \| 'right top' \| 'right bottom' \| 'end' \| 'end top' \| 'end bottom'` |  | `'bottom end'` | Side and alignment relative to the trigger. Default `bottom start`. Flips on collision. |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` |  |  | Controlled open state. Pair with `onOpenChange`. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  |  | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(isOpen: boolean) => void` |  |  | Called when the menu opens or closes. |
| `popoverClassName` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the popover that holds the menu. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the menu list element. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`
