| `suggestions` | `readonly (string \| SearchSuggestion)[]` |  |  | Suggestions shown under the box while typing, matched accent- and case-insensitively against `label` with the matching part highlighted. Strings are shorthand for `{ label }`. Without this prop the component is a plain search field (`role="searchbox"`); with it the input is a combobox (`role="combobox"`). Keep the array order: it is the order shown. |
| `onSelect` | `((suggestion: SearchSuggestion) => void)` |  |  | Called when a suggestion is chosen (click or `Enter` on the highlighted one). |
| `maxResults` | `number` |  |  | Most suggestions shown. Default `6`. |
| `shortcut` | `readonly string[]` |  |  | A decorative hint of the global shortcut that focuses the search (`['Mod', 'K']`, `['/']`), drawn with `Kbd` while the box is empty. It does not register the shortcut: use `useHotkey` and focus `inputRef` yourself. Hidden from assistive technology, since the hint is only useful when the shortcut exists; announce it with `aria-keyshortcuts` if it does. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  | Text shown while the box is empty. Default from messages: "Search". |
| `landmark` | `boolean` |  |  | Wraps the field in a `role="search"` landmark named by the label. Use it once per page for the main search of a page or site; not for filters inside a table. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  |  | Control height: `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (default), `lg` 48px. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the field root. |
| `popoverClassName` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the popover that holds the suggestions. |
| `inputRef` | `Ref<HTMLInputElement>` |  |  | Ref to the `<input>` element. The `ref` prop points at the field root. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ clear: string; placeholder: string; noResults: string; } & { requiredMark: string; }>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance: `clear`, `placeholder`, `noResults`. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the field root `<div>`. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Visible label. Prefer it: sighted and assistive technology users see the same name. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label (for example a search box with an icon). |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the field. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`
- From `AriaSearchFieldProps` (react-aria): `enterKeyHint`, `type`
- From `AriaTextFieldProps` (react-aria): `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-autocomplete`, `aria-controls`, `aria-haspopup`
- From `AriaValidationProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-errormessage`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `FocusableDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `excludeFromTabOrder`
- From `FocusableProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoFocus`
- From `FocusEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBlur`, `onFocus`, `onFocusChange`
- From `InputBase` (@react-types/shared): `isDisabled`, `isReadOnly`
- From `InputDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `form`, `name`
- From `KeyboardEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onKeyDown`, `onKeyUp`
- From `SearchFieldProps` (react-stately): `onClear`, `onSubmit`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- From `TextInputDOMEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBeforeInput`, `onCompositionEnd`, `onCompositionStart`, `onCompositionUpdate`, `onCopy`, `onCut`, `onInput`, `onPaste`
- From `TextInputDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoComplete`, `autoCorrect`, `inputMode`, `maxLength`, `minLength`, `pattern`, `spellCheck`
- From `Validation` (@react-types/shared): `isInvalid`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ SearchInput: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clear` | `Clear search` | Accessible name of the clear button. |
| `placeholder` | `Search` | Placeholder when none is given. |
| `noResults` | `No results` | Shown in the suggestions list when nothing matches the text. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-combobox-popover-max-height`, `--ds-field-control-padding-inline`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-item-h`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-radius-lg`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-space-6`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-surface-raised`, `--ds-target-min`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-weight-medium`, `--ds-z-dropdown`

#### When to use

- Searching a list, a table or the app, with or without suggestions.

#### When not to use

- Choosing a value from a list: `Combobox` (it keeps a selected value; SearchInput keeps free text).
- Filters with several fields: compose `Input`, `Select`.

#### Modes

| Mode               | Element                                  | Notes                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Plain (default)    | `input[type=search]`, `role="searchbox"` | Clear button; `Escape` clears; `onSubmit(text)` on `Enter`.                                                                                                |
| With `suggestions` | `role="combobox"`                        | List under the box while there is text. `Escape` closes the list, then clears. `Enter` on a highlighted suggestion calls `onSelect`; otherwise `onSubmit`. |

#### Props (key ones)

| Prop                                                                                                  | Notes                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `aria-label` / `label` / `aria-labelledby`                                                            | One is required. Most searches use `aria-label` ("Search products") and no visible label.                                                                                      |
| `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(text)`                                                           | Controlled / uncontrolled text.                                                                                                                                                |
| `onSubmit(text)`, `onClear()`                                                                         | `Enter` and the clear action.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `suggestions`, `onSelect`, `maxResults`                                                               | Strings or `{ label, meta, data }`. Matched on `label` with `matchesSearch`, highlighted with `highlightMatch`, at most `maxResults` (default 6), in the order given.          |
| `shortcut`                                                                                            | Decorative hint such as `['Mod', 'K']`, drawn with `Kbd` while the box is empty. It registers nothing: use `useHotkey` and focus `inputRef`. Hidden from assistive technology. |
| `landmark`                                                                                            | Wraps the field in `role="search"` named by the label. Once per page.                                                                                                          |
| `size`, `placeholder`, `name`, `isDisabled`, `isReadOnly`, `autoFocus`, `inputRef`, `ref`, `messages` | `messages`: `clear`, `placeholder`, `noResults`.                                                                                                                               |

#### Accessibility and keyboard

| Key                     | Behavior                                                                    |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Typing                  | Plain: updates the text. Suggestions: opens the list when there are matches |
| `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` | (Suggestions) move through the list; focus stays in the input               |
| `Enter`                 | Select the highlighted suggestion, else `onSubmit(text)`                    |
| `Escape`                | Plain: clear. Suggestions: close the list, then clear                       |

The clear button is "Clear search" (from messages), out of the tab order in suggestions mode, hidden while the box is empty. Highlighted parts are `<mark>` without a background: only weight and brightness change, so contrast holds.

#### Content rules

`aria-label` names the scope ("Search products"), not the control. Placeholder "Search" is a hint, never the name.

#### Example

```tsx
<SearchInput
  aria-label="Search products"
  value={query}
  onChange={setQuery}
  suggestions={products}
  onSelect={(product) => open(product.data)}
  shortcut={['/']}
/>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Combobox: Choosing a value from a list: `Combobox` (it keeps a selected value; SearchInput keeps free text).
- Instead, see Input: Filters with several fields: compose `Input`, `Select`.
- Instead, see Select: Filters with several fields: compose `Input`, `Select`.
- Renders: Icon, Kbd

### SegmentedControl

> A segmented control picks one value from a few options, like a radio group drawn as a
bar. It is a value control: it does not own panels (use `Tabs` for that). Exactly one
option is always selected.

Built on React Aria `ToggleButtonGroup` with single selection and no empty selection:
it is exposed as a radio group, with one tab stop and arrow-key navigation.

A bar of two to five options where exactly one is selected, like a radio group drawn as buttons. It is a value control: it changes how something is shown or filtered, it does not own panels. Built on React Aria `ToggleButtonGroup` with single selection and no empty selection.

- Handoff source: `components/forms/SegmentedControl.jsx` (TODO `CMP-FRM-09`).

- Import: `import { SegmentedControl } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/SegmentedControl`): Default, Small, FullWidth, WithCounts, DisabledOption, DisabledGroup, KeyboardSelection, Controlled, LongLabels, PortugueseCounts, RightToLeft, Focused

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly SegmentedControlOption[]` | yes |  | The options, in display order. Two to five fit comfortably. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name of the group ("View"). Required: name this or use `aria-labelledby`. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the group. |
| `value` | `string` |  |  | Selected option (controlled). |
| `defaultValue` | `string` |  |  | Initially selected option (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first enabled option. |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  |  | Called with the new value when the user selects another option. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` |  | `'md'` | Height of the segments: `sm` 24px, `md` 32px (default). |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Stretch to the container; the segments share the width equally. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the group element. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`
- From `DOMRenderProps` (react-aria-components): `render`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- From `ToggleGroupProps` (react-stately): `isDisabled`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-bg`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-line-control`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-md`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-segmented-control-height-md`, `--ds-segmented-control-height-sm`, `--ds-segmented-control-padding`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-surface`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-weight-medium`, `--ds-weight-regular`

#### When to use

- A view mode (List, Board, Calendar), a period (Day, Week, Month) or a small filter (All, Open, Closed).
- When the options are always visible and the change applies immediately.

#### When not to use

- To switch between panels of content: use `Tabs`.
- For more than five options, or long labels: use `Select` or `RadioGroup`.
- For on/off settings: use `Switch`.

#### Anatomy

```
div[role=radiogroup] aria-label        (bordered track)
  button[role=radio] aria-checked      (one per option)
    label
    count                              (optional, mono)
```

#### Accessibility

- Semantics: `radiogroup` with `radio` buttons and `aria-checked`. It is deliberately not a `tablist`.
- Keyboard: one tab stop; `←` / `→` move focus between options, `Space` selects the focused option. React Aria does not wrap at the ends. Disabled options are skipped. The selection can never be empty.
- Selected state is shown by a raised background, a line and ink text, not by color alone. The track border uses `--ds-line-control` (3:1).
- The count uses `--ds-text-2`: `--ds-text-3` would fail 4.5:1 on the selected surface.
- Focus: accent border and ring. Forced colors: the selected segment border uses `Highlight`.

#### Content rules

- Labels are one word or a short phrase in sentence case ("Open", "This week").
- Same-length labels look best; avoid mixing a count on some options only.

#### Examples

```tsx
<SegmentedControl
  aria-label="View"
  options={[
    { value: 'list', label: 'List' },
    { value: 'board', label: 'Board' },
  ]}
  value={view}
  onChange={setView}
/>

<SegmentedControl
  aria-label="Order status"
  size="sm"
  options={[
    { value: 'all', label: 'All', count: 1248 },
    { value: 'open', label: 'Open', count: 12, countLabel: '12 open' },
  ]}
/>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Tabs: To switch between panels of content: use `Tabs`.
- Instead, see Select: For more than five options, or long labels: use `Select` or `RadioGroup`.
- Instead, see RadioGroup: For more than five options, or long labels: use `Select` or `RadioGroup`.
- Instead, see Switch: For on/off settings: use `Switch`.
- Renders: VisuallyHidden

### Select

> A single-choice dropdown built on React Aria `Select`: a button that opens a listbox in a
popover. Keyboard: Enter, Space or the arrow keys open it; typing selects by prefix (typeahead);
Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger. A hidden native `<select>` carries `name` and
the value into form submission and browser autofill.

Use it for 4 or more options; for 2 to 4 prefer `RadioGroup`.

Single-choice dropdown: a button that opens a listbox in a popover. Built on React Aria `Select` (`Button`, `SelectValue`, `Popover`, `ListBox`). A hidden native `<select>` carries `name` and the value into form submission and autofill. Shared field behavior is in [Field](../Field/Field.md).

- Import: `import { Select } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Select/Select.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Select`): Default, KeyboardAndTypeahead, EscapeClosesAndRestoresFocus, Open, WithSelection, WithDescription, Required, Invalid, Disabled, Sizes, DisabledOptions, Sections, LongLabels

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly (SelectOption \| SelectGroup)[]` | yes |  | The options, or groups of options. Keep the order you want users to see (see Select.md). |
| `value` | `string \| null` |  |  | The selected `value`; `null` means nothing is selected. Pair with `onChange`. |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| null` |  |  | The initially selected `value` when uncontrolled. |
| `onChange` | `((value: string \| null) => void)` |  |  | Called with the new `value`. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Helper text under the control. Linked with `aria-describedby`. |
| `errorMessage` | `FieldErrorMessage` |  |  | Error text, shown while the field is invalid and the error is displayed. See `Input`. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  | Trigger text while nothing is selected. Default from messages: "Select an option". |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  | `'md'` | Control height: `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (default), `lg` 48px. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the field root. |
| `popoverClassName` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the popover that holds the options. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ placeholder: string; } & { requiredMark: string; }>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance: `placeholder`, `requiredMark`. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the field root `<div>`. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Visible label. Prefer it: sighted and assistive technology users see the same name. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label (for example a search box with an icon). |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the field. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`
- From `AriaSelectProps` (react-aria): `autoComplete`, `form`, `name`
- From `CollectionBase` (@react-types/shared): `disabledKeys`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `DOMRenderProps` (react-aria-components): `render`
- From `FocusableDOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `excludeFromTabOrder`
- From `FocusableProps` (@react-types/shared): `autoFocus`
- From `FocusEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onBlur`, `onFocus`, `onFocusChange`
- From `InputBase` (@react-types/shared): `isDisabled`
- From `KeyboardEvents` (@react-types/shared): `onKeyDown`, `onKeyUp`
- From `RACValidation` (react-aria-components): `validationBehavior`
- From `SelectProps` (react-stately): `allowsEmptyCollection`, `defaultOpen`, `isOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `shouldCloseOnSelect`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- From `Validation` (@react-types/shared): `isInvalid`, `isRequired`, `validate`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Select: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `placeholder` | `Select an option` | Shown in the trigger while nothing is selected. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-field-control-padding-inline`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-item-h`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-lg`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-select-popover-max-height`, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-surface-hover`, `--ds-surface-raised`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-tracking-caption`, `--ds-z-dropdown`

#### When to use

- A choice from 4 or more options.

#### When not to use

- 2 to 4 options that users compare: `RadioGroup` (or a segmented control).
- Typing to filter a long list: `ComboBox` (planned).
- Several selections: `CheckboxGroup`.

#### Props (key ones)

| Prop                                            | Notes                                                                                               |
| ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label`, `description`, `errorMessage`          | As in `Input`.                                                                                      |
| `options`                                       | `SelectOption[]` (`value`, `label`, `isDisabled`) or groups `{ id, label, options }`, mixed freely. |
| `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value)`    | The selected option `value`; `null` means nothing selected. `onChange` receives `string \| null`.   |
| `placeholder`                                   | Trigger text while empty. Default from messages: "Select an option" (pt-BR "Selecione uma opção").  |
| `size`                                          | `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (default), `lg` 48px.                                                          |
| `name`, `isRequired`, `isInvalid`, `isDisabled` | Standard. `name` is submitted through the hidden `<select>`.                                        |
| `popoverClassName`, `className`, `ref`          | Styling hooks; `ref` is the field root.                                                             |
| `messages`                                      | `placeholder`, `requiredMark`.                                                                      |

Option order is yours: the component never reorders. The product rule that lists are alphabetical by default applies to what you pass in: use `sortByText(options, (o) => o.label, locale)` from `loui-ds` (locale- and accent-aware) unless the order carries meaning (sizes, steps).

#### Anatomy and styling

- Trigger: the same box as `Input` (`--ds-line-control` border, focus ring, no hover fill), with a chevron.
- Popover: raised surface, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, radius `lg`, layer `--ds-z-dropdown`, at least as wide as the trigger, scrolls above `--ds-select-popover-max-height`.
- Option: `--ds-item-h` (36px) tall, hover and keyboard focus use `--ds-surface-hover`, the selected option shows a check (`Icon`), disabled options use the shared opacity.
- Section captions are mono, uppercase by CSS, in `--ds-text-2` (`--ds-text-3` fails contrast on the raised surface).

#### Accessibility and keyboard

| Key                                      | Behavior                                                       |
| ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Enter`, `Space`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowUp` | Open the list and focus the selected (or first/last) option    |
| `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp`                  | Next / previous enabled option                                 |
| `Home` / `End`                           | First / last option                                            |
| Letters                                  | Typeahead: focus the option starting with what you type        |
| `Enter` / `Space`                        | Select the focused option, close, focus returns to the trigger |
| `Escape`                                 | Close without changing; focus returns to the trigger           |
| Typing on the closed trigger             | Selects by prefix without opening                              |

The trigger is a `button` with `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, named by the label and described by the description and error. Options are `role="option"` with `aria-selected`; sections are `role="group"` named by their caption; disabled options have `aria-disabled`.

#### Example

```tsx
<Select
  label="Region"
  name="region"
  options={[
    { value: 'eu', label: 'EU: Frankfurt' },
    { value: 'us', label: 'US: Virginia' },
  ]}
  isRequired
  errorMessage="Choose a region."
/>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see RadioGroup: 2 to 4 options that users compare: `RadioGroup` (or a segmented control).
- Instead, see CheckboxGroup: Several selections: `CheckboxGroup`.
- Renders: FieldMessages, Icon, Label

### Sheet

> A side panel that slides in from the inline-end edge, for viewing or editing one record
without leaving the list. Built on React Aria `Modal` and `Dialog`: focus is trapped and
restored, the page is inert and does not scroll, and `Escape` closes only the top-most layer
(a `Dialog` opened from a sheet closes first).

The header (title, mono meta, extra content, close button) is `--ds-topbar-h` tall; the body
scrolls; the footer stays at the bottom.

A side panel that slides in from the inline-end edge to view or edit one record without leaving the list. Built on React Aria `Modal` and `Dialog`. Generic: it lives in the core entry point.

- Handoff source: `components/erp/Sheet` (CMP-PAT-01).

- Import: `import { Sheet } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Sheet/Sheet.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Sheet`): Default, Open, Medium, Large, CloseButton, LongContent, NotPadded, LongTitle, WithDescription, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | yes |  | Heading of the sheet and its accessible name. One line; it is truncated with an ellipsis. |
| `meta` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Short mono text after the title, such as a record code ("ORD-1048"). |
| `headerExtra` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Extra header content after the meta, usually a `Badge` with the status. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Optional description linked to the sheet with `aria-describedby`. |
| `children` | `ReactNode \| ((options: SheetRenderOptions) => ReactNode)` |  |  | Body of the sheet; it scrolls when it is taller than the viewport. A function receives `close`. |
| `footer` | `ReactNode \| ((options: SheetRenderOptions) => ReactNode)` |  |  | Footer actions, aligned to the end: Cancel (secondary) then the primary action. A function receives `close`. The footer stays at the bottom while the body scrolls. |
| `footerStart` | `ReactNode \| ((options: SheetRenderOptions) => ReactNode)` |  |  | Footer content aligned to the start, for the destructive action ("Delete order"). |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  | `'sm'` | Width: `sm` 440px (default), `md` 460px, `lg` 480px. Full width on small screens. |
| `padded` | `boolean` |  | `true` | Pads the body (24px, 18px between children). Turn off for a table or a full-bleed list. Default `true`. |
| `trigger` | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>>` |  |  | The element that opens the sheet. Optional: omit it and control the sheet with `isOpen`. |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` |  |  | Controlled open state. Pair with `onOpenChange`. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  |  | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(isOpen: boolean) => void` |  |  | Called when the sheet opens or closes. |
| `isDismissable` | `boolean` |  | `true` | Whether pressing the scrim closes the sheet. Default `true`. |
| `isKeyboardDismissDisabled` | `boolean` |  |  | Disables closing with `Escape`. Use it only while a request is running. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ close: string; }>` |  |  | Per-instance overrides of the built-in messages. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the sheet panel. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLElement>` |  |  | Ref to the sheet panel. |

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Sheet: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | `Close panel` | Name of the close button in the Sheet header. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-heading`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-lh-heading`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-line-subtle`, `--ds-scrim`, `--ds-shadow-dialog`, `--ds-sheet-from`, `--ds-sheet-padding`, `--ds-sheet-width`, `--ds-sheet-width-lg`, `--ds-sheet-width-md`, `--ds-sheet-width-sm`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-space-4`, `--ds-surface`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-topbar-h`, `--ds-weight-semibold`

#### When to use

- A record's details or edit form next to the list it came from.
- Filters or settings with a footer of actions.

#### When not to use

- A short confirmation or a small form: use `Dialog`.
- A hint or a few controls on a trigger: use `Popover`.
- Page-level navigation: use `Sidebar`.

#### Anatomy

```
DialogTrigger
  trigger
  ModalOverlay       --ds-scrim, z sheet
    Modal            surface, strong line at the start edge, dialog shadow, width sm | md | lg
      Dialog         role=dialog, aria-labelledby = title
        header       --ds-topbar-h tall: title (ellipsis) · meta (mono) · headerExtra · close IconButton
        body         scrolls; padded (24px) or not
        footer       sticky: footerStart (destructive) ... footer (Cancel + primary)
```

#### Accessibility

- Same overlay contract as `Dialog`: focus trapped and restored, `inert` page, scroll lock, `Escape` closes only the top layer (a `Dialog` opened inside the sheet closes first; tested in `Dialog.test.tsx`).
- Named by the title through `aria-labelledby`, so a non-string title works (the handoff only labeled string titles).
- The close button is an `IconButton` named from messages. The handoff set `title="Close (Esc)"`.
- Slide-in is a 150 ms transform and the scrim fades; both are removed under `prefers-reduced-motion`. The slide direction follows the writing direction (`:dir(rtl)`).
- The panel is `Modal` content inside the overlay, so it stacks above the scrim without a second z-index.
- See the Dialog doc ("Layers") for popovers opened from inside the sheet.

#### Content rules

- Title: the record type or name, sentence case. Meta: its code, as data.
- Footer: destructive action at the start ("Delete order"); Cancel then the primary action at the end ("Save order"). Deleting still goes through a `ConfirmDialog`.

#### Examples

```tsx
<Sheet
  trigger={<Button>View order</Button>}
  title="Order"
  meta="ORD-1048"
  headerExtra={<Badge tone="success">Shipped</Badge>}
  footerStart={<Button variant="danger">Delete order</Button>}
  footer={({ close }) => (
    <>
      <Button onPress={close}>Cancel</Button>
      <Button variant="primary" onPress={save}>
        Save order
      </Button>
    </>
  )}
>
  <Input label="Customer" />
</Sheet>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Dialog: A short confirmation or a small form: use `Dialog`.
- Instead, see Popover: A hint or a few controls on a trigger: use `Popover`.
- Instead, see Sidebar: Page-level navigation: use `Sidebar`.
- Renders: IconButton

### ShortcutsHelp

> A dialog that lists the registered keyboard shortcuts (`useHotkeys` with a `description`),
grouped by their `group`, one table per group with the keys drawn by `Kbd`. Opens with `?` by
default. Place it once, anywhere under the app, and it stays in sync with what is mounted.

A dialog that lists the keyboard shortcuts registered on the page, one table per group, with the keys drawn by `Kbd`. It opens with `?` by default.

- Import: `import { ShortcutsHelp } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/ShortcutsHelp/ShortcutsHelp.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/ShortcutsHelp`): Default, Open, Empty, PortugueseBrazil

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` |  |  | Controlled open state. Pair with `onOpenChange`. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| `onOpenChange` | `((isOpen: boolean) => void)` |  |  | Called when the dialog opens (from the hotkey) or closes. |
| `hotkey` | `string \| false` |  | `?` | The shortcut that opens the dialog, registered in the hotkey registry. Default `'?'`. It does not fire while an input has focus, so typing a question mark still works. Pass `false` to open the dialog only through `isOpen`. |
| `includeInactive` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Also list shortcuts whose scope is not active right now. Default `false`. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ title: string; description: string; ungrouped: string; empty: string; close: string; action: string; keys: string; openDescription: string; openGroup: string; }>` |  |  | Message overrides for this instance. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the dialog panel. |

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ ShortcutsHelp: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Keyboard shortcuts` | Title of the dialog. |
| `description` | `Shortcuts that work on this page.` | Description under the title. |
| `ungrouped` | `Other` | Heading for shortcuts that have no `group`. |
| `empty` | `No keyboard shortcuts on this page.` | Shown when no shortcut is registered. |
| `close` | `Close` | Label of the button that closes the dialog. |
| `action` | `Action` | Column header: what the shortcut does. |
| `keys` | `Shortcut` | Column header: the keys. |
| `openDescription` | `Show keyboard shortcuts` | Description of the shortcut that opens the dialog. |
| `openGroup` | `General` | Group of the shortcut that opens the dialog. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-line-subtle`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-4`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-tracking-caption`, `--ds-weight-regular`

#### When to use

- Once per app (or per module), next to the `CommandPalette`, so users can learn the shortcuts without leaving the page.

#### When not to use

- To register shortcuts: use `useHotkeys`. This only lists what is registered.
- As the only way to find a command: the `CommandPalette` also searches by name.

#### Anatomy

```
Dialog "Keyboard shortcuts"  (size md, Close button)
  table  caption = group
    tr   th[scope=row] description · td Kbd keys
```

#### Behavior

- Lists shortcuts that have a `description` (`useHotkeys`). Groups are sorted with the locale; shortcuts without a `group` go under "Other", last. Rows are sorted by description.
- Updates while it is open: shortcuts that mount or unmount appear or disappear.
- It lists itself ("Show keyboard shortcuts") and the `CommandPalette` shortcut.
- While it is open, page shortcuts do not fire.

#### Accessibility

- A modal `dialog` named "Keyboard shortcuts" with a description; focus is trapped and returns on close.
- Each group is a real `<table>` named by its `<caption>`; the description is the row header, the keys are the cell. The column headers exist for screen readers and are visually hidden.
- Keys use `Kbd`, with spoken names for symbols.
- `Escape` and the Close button close it.

#### Content rules

- Descriptions are verb plus object in sentence case ("Create order"), as in the command palette.
- Messages: `title`, `description`, `ungrouped`, `empty`, `close`, `action`, `keys`, `openDescription`, `openGroup`. English and pt-BR ship.

#### Examples

```tsx
<HotkeyProvider>
  <App />
  <ShortcutsHelp />
</HotkeyProvider>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see CommandPalette: As the only way to find a command: the `CommandPalette` also searches by name.
- Renders: Button, Dialog, Kbd, VisuallyHidden

### Sidebar

> The app sidebar: a workspace block, navigation sections, an optional status card, a footer
slot and the signed-in user. It is an `aside` landmark; each section is a separate `nav`
landmark named by its caption. It is `--ds-sidebar-w` wide and scrolls on its own when it is
taller than its container, so give the parent a fixed height.

Reading order and focus order follow the visual order: sections top to bottom, then the
footer. Collapsing or an off-canvas mobile variant is not part of this component.

The app sidebar: workspace block, navigation sections, optional status card, footer slot and the signed-in user. It is an `aside` landmark and each section is its own `nav`.

- Handoff source: `components/layout/Sidebar.jsx` (TODO `CMP-LAY-01`).

- Import: `import { Sidebar } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Sidebar/Sidebar.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Sidebar`): Default, Complete, StatusTones, WithoutCaptions, FocusOrder, Controlled, ManyItems, LongText, Portuguese, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace` | `SidebarWorkspace` | yes |  | The workspace block at the top. |
| `sections` | `readonly SidebarSection[]` | yes |  | Navigation groups. Each one is its own labelled `nav` landmark. |
| `value` | `string` |  |  | `value` of the active item (gets `aria-current="page"`). |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  |  | Called with the `value` of the item the user pressed. |
| `status` | `SidebarStatus` |  |  | Optional status card above the footer. |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Free slot above the user block, for example a help link or an upgrade note. |
| `user` | `SidebarUser` |  |  | The signed-in user, at the bottom. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Overrides the accessible name of the landmark (default "Sidebar" from the catalog). |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ label: string; }>` |  |  | Per-instance overrides of the built-in messages. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Sidebar: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `Sidebar` | Accessible name of the sidebar landmark. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-bg`, `--ds-danger`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-caption`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-fs-meta`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-lh-caption`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-lh-meta`, `--ds-line`, `--ds-line-subtle`, `--ds-nav-item-padding-inline`, `--ds-primary-bg`, `--ds-primary-fg`, `--ds-radius-lg`, `--ds-radius-md`, `--ds-radius-pill`, `--ds-sidebar-gap`, `--ds-sidebar-padding-block`, `--ds-sidebar-padding-inline`, `--ds-sidebar-status-dot-size`, `--ds-sidebar-w`, `--ds-sidebar-workspace-mark-size`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-success`, `--ds-surface`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-tracking-caption`, `--ds-warning`, `--ds-weight-medium`, `--ds-weight-semibold`

#### When to use

- The persistent primary navigation of an app shell, next to the content and below a `SkipLink`.

#### When not to use

- For in-page navigation or a table of contents.
- For mobile off-canvas navigation: collapsing and responsive behavior are not part of this component yet.

#### Anatomy

```
aside[aria-label="Sidebar"]         (--ds-sidebar-w wide, scrolls on its own)
  workspace                         (initial tile, name, subtitle)
  nav[aria-labelledby=caption]      (one per section)
    caption                         (mono, uppercase by CSS)
    ul > li > NavItem
  bottom
    status                          (role=status: dot + title + meta/value)
    footer                          (slot)
    user                            (Avatar + name + role)
```

#### Layout

- Width is `--ds-sidebar-w` (240px). The handoff's `width` prop and 248px default are dropped; there is one width in the system.
- The sidebar uses `max-block-size: 100%` and `overflow-y: auto`: give its parent a definite height (for example a full-height flex row) and it scrolls on its own while the content scrolls separately. The status, footer and user stay at the bottom when there is room.

#### Accessibility

- Landmarks: `aside` (complementary) named "Sidebar", and one `nav` per section named by its visible caption (or by `label` when there is no caption). Names are unique, so landmark lists are meaningful.
- Items are in a `ul`, so screen readers announce "list, 5 items".
- Focus order follows the visual order: sections top to bottom, then the footer, then nothing in the status or user blocks (they are text).
- The status block is `role="status"` (polite live region): a change from "Synced" to "Sync failed" is announced. The dot is `aria-hidden`; the title says the status in words.
- The workspace tile and the user avatar are decorative because the names are shown next to them.
- The active item has `aria-current="page"` (see `NavItem`).

#### Content rules

- Section captions are written in sentence case ("Work"); the CSS makes them uppercase mono.
- Status titles say the state: "All systems operational", not "OK".

#### Examples

```tsx
<Sidebar
  workspace={{ name: 'Northwind', subtitle: 'Production' }}
  value="orders"
  onChange={setView}
  sections={[
    {
      id: 'work',
      title: 'Work',
      items: [
        {
          value: 'orders',
          label: 'Orders',
          href: '/orders',
          icon: StarIcon,
          count: 3,
          countLabel: '3 pending',
          countTone: 'warning',
        },
        { value: 'customers', label: 'Customers', href: '/customers' },
      ],
    },
  ]}
  status={{ title: 'All systems operational', meta: 'Last sync', value: '2 min ago' }}
  user={{ name: 'Ana Souza', role: 'Owner' }}
/>
```

#### Related components

- Renders: Avatar, NavItem

### Skeleton

> A placeholder block in the shape of content that is still loading. It is always hidden
from assistive technology: mark the region that is loading with `aria-busy="true"` and
remove the attribute (and the skeletons) when the content arrives.

The `width` and `height` props are the only dynamic values in the library that reach the
DOM as custom properties on `style`, because arbitrary sizes cannot be tokens.

A placeholder in the shape of content that is still loading: a block, a circle, or a few text lines.

- Import: `import { Skeleton } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Skeleton/Skeleton.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Skeleton`): Default, Block, Circle, Lines, SingleLine, Pill, BusyRegion, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `string \| number` |  |  | Width: a number in px or any CSS length. Default `100%`. Ignored when `circle` is set (the circle is as wide as it is tall). |
| `height` | `string \| number` |  |  | Height of the block, or of each line: a number in px or any CSS length. Default `12px` (`--ds-skeleton-height`). |
| `circle` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Renders a circle, for an avatar. The diameter is `height`. |
| `lines` | `number` |  |  | Renders this many text lines; the last one is shorter. Takes precedence over `circle`. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-radius-pill`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-skeleton-height`, `--ds-skeleton-pulse-duration`, `--ds-skeleton-pulse-opacity`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-surface-hover`

#### When to use

- The layout of the content is known (a list of rows, a card, an avatar next to text) and the wait is short.
- Keep the page from jumping when the data arrives.

#### When not to use

- For an action in progress (saving, sending): use `Spinner` or a loading `Button`.
- For a measurable task: use `Progress`.
- When there is nothing to show after loading: use `EmptyState`.

#### Anatomy

```
span[aria-hidden="true"]  block | circle
span[aria-hidden="true"]  lines → n × span (last one is 60% wide)
```

#### Accessibility

- Every skeleton is `aria-hidden="true"`: it is decoration and has no text.
- **Mark the region that is loading with `aria-busy="true"`** and remove it, together with the skeletons, when the content arrives. This tells assistive technology the region is being updated. A skeleton on its own does not do this.
- If the wait is long, also expose a polite status ("Loading orders") near the region; skeletons never announce it.
- The pulse (opacity only) is switched off under `prefers-reduced-motion`. In forced-colors mode the placeholder gets a border because background colors are dropped.

#### Content rules

- Match the final layout: the same number of rows and similar widths, so nothing moves when the data arrives.
- Show at most one screenful of placeholders.

#### Examples

```tsx
<section aria-busy={isLoading} aria-label="Recent orders">
  {isLoading ? (
    <>
      <Skeleton circle height={28} />
      <Skeleton lines={3} />
    </>
  ) : (
    <OrderList orders={orders} />
  )}
</section>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Spinner: For an action in progress (saving, sending): use `Spinner` or a loading `Button`.
- Instead, see Button: For an action in progress (saving, sending): use `Spinner` or a loading `Button`.
- Instead, see Progress: For a measurable task: use `Progress`.
- Instead, see EmptyState: When there is nothing to show after loading: use `EmptyState`.
- Used by: DataTable

### SkipLink

> A link that is invisible until a keyboard user focuses it, then jumps past the repeated
navigation to the main content (WCAG 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks). Put it as the very first
focusable element of the page, before the sidebar and the top bar.

It moves focus itself instead of relying on the hash navigation, so it also works with hash
based routers and with a target that is not focusable by default.

A link that stays invisible until a keyboard user focuses it, then jumps past the repeated navigation to the main content (WCAG 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks).

- Source: TODO `BASE-002` (there was no handoff component).

- Import: `import { SkipLink } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/SkipLink/SkipLink.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/SkipLink`): Default, JumpsToMain, CustomTarget, Portuguese, RightToLeft, Focused

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `targetId` | `string` |  | `main` | Id of the element to jump to, without the `#`. Default `main`. The element should be the page's `<main>` (or its first heading); it does not need a `tabindex`. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Link text. Defaults to "Skip to main content" from the message catalog. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ label: string; }>` |  |  | Per-instance overrides of the built-in messages. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ SkipLink: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `Skip to main content` | Default text of the skip link. |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-small`, `--ds-lh-small`, `--ds-primary-bg`, `--ds-primary-fg`, `--ds-radius-md`, `--ds-skip-link-z-index`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-space-4`, `--ds-weight-medium`

#### When to use

- Once per page, as the first focusable element, before the sidebar and the top bar.

#### When not to use

- As a general "go to section" link: use `Link`.

#### Behavior

- Hidden with the same technique as `VisuallyHidden` (1px, clipped), so it is still focusable. On focus it becomes a primary-colored button at the top start corner, above everything (`--ds-skip-link-z-index`).
- On activation it focuses the target element itself and cancels the hash navigation. This works with hash-based routers and with targets that are not focusable (a temporary `tabindex="-1"` is added and removed on blur; an existing `tabindex` is kept). If the target does not exist, the browser's default behavior runs.
- Give the target `id="main"`; put it on `<main>`.

#### Accessibility

- It is a real link, so it appears in link lists and works with `Enter`.
- Visible focus with the accent ring; forced colors use `Highlight`.
- The text says where it goes. Do not shorten it to "Skip".

#### Content rules

- "Skip to main content" (default). For a second link use the destination: "Skip to the results".

#### Examples

```tsx
<>
  <SkipLink />
  <Sidebar … />
  <main id="main">…</main>
</>
```

#### `.ds-sr-only` (BASE-002)

The TODO asks for a `.ds-sr-only` utility class too. It belongs in `src/styles/base.css` (`@layer utilities`), a shared file this component does not own. The rule to add is the same as `.root` of `VisuallyHidden` (absolute, 1px, `clip-path: inset(50%)`, no overflow).

#### Related components

- Instead, see Link: As a general "go to section" link: use `Link`.
- Used by: AppShell, AppShellNavToggle

### Slider

> A single-value slider built on React Aria `Slider`: a labelled track with one thumb that is a
real `<input type="range">`, so keyboard, pointer, touch and form submission (`name`) work
natively. Keys: arrows step by `step`, `PageUp`/`PageDown` move by a larger step (10% of the
range, at least `step`), `Home`/`End` jump to the limits.

Range selection with two thumbs is not part of this component yet.

Single-value slider: a labelled track with one thumb and a formatted value. Built on React Aria `Slider` (`SliderTrack`, `SliderFill`, `SliderThumb`, `SliderOutput`). The thumb is a real `<input type="range">`, so keyboard, pointer, touch and form submission work natively. Task: CMP-INP-04.

- Import: `import { Slider } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Slider/Slider.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Slider`): Default, KeyboardContract, Percent, WithDescription, SteppedByTen, WithoutValue, Disabled, AriaLabelOnly, Controlled, LongLabel

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` |  |  | The value when controlled. Pair with `onChange`. |
| `defaultValue` | `number` |  |  | The initial value when uncontrolled. Defaults to `minValue`. |
| `onChange` | `((value: number) => void)` |  |  | Called while the value changes (each key press, each pointer move). |
| `onChangeEnd` | `((value: number) => void)` |  |  | Called once when a drag ends or a key press is committed. Use it to save. |
| `formatOptions` | `NumberFormatOptions` |  |  | Formats the value shown next to the label and spoken to screen readers (`aria-valuetext`): `{ style: 'percent' }`, `{ style: 'unit', unit: 'kilometer' }`, ... Uses the locale of `DSProvider`. |
| `name` | `string` |  |  | Name for form submission; the form receives the number. |
| `showValue` | `boolean` |  | `true` | Shows the formatted value (mono) on the right of the label. Default `true`. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Helper text under the track, linked with `aria-describedby`. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  | Class name for the field root. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  | Ref to the field root `<div>`. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  |  | Visible label. Prefer it: sighted and assistive technology users see the same name. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label (for example a search box with an icon). |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the field. |

##### Inherited props

- From `AriaLabelingProps` (@react-types/shared): `aria-describedby`, `aria-details`
- From `DOMProps` (@react-types/shared): `id`
- From `DOMRenderProps` (react-aria-components): `render`
- From `SliderProps` (react-stately): `isDisabled`, `maxValue`, `minValue`, `step`
- From `SlotProps` (react-aria-components): `slot`
- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-line-control`, `--ds-line-strong`, `--ds-opacity-disabled`, `--ds-radius-pill`, `--ds-slider-thumb-dot-size`, `--ds-slider-thumb-size`, `--ds-slider-track-height`, `--ds-space-3`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`

#### When to use

- Picking a number from a bounded range where the approximate value matters more than the exact one (discount, opacity, threshold).

#### When not to use

- An exact quantity: `NumberField`. Money: `CurrencyInput`.
- A range with two ends: not supported yet (two-thumb range is P2).
- Fewer than about five discrete choices: `RadioGroup` or a segmented control.

#### Anatomy

- Header: `Label` (left) and the formatted value in mono (right, `SliderOutput`).
- Track: rail (`--ds-line-control`, 3:1 against the page), fill from the start to the thumb (`--ds-accent`), thumb.
- Thumb: a 24px hit area (`--ds-slider-thumb-size`, WCAG 2.5.8) with a 16px visible knob; the focus ring follows the hit area.
- Optional description under the track.

#### Props (key ones)

| Prop                                         | Notes                                                                                            |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `label` / `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`   | One is required (types and a development warning).                                               |
| `value` / `defaultValue` / `onChange(value)` | Controlled / uncontrolled, RAC naming. `onChange` fires on every step; `onChangeEnd` on commit.  |
| `minValue`, `maxValue`, `step`               | Defaults `0`, `100`, `1`.                                                                        |
| `formatOptions`                              | `Intl.NumberFormat` options for the shown value and `aria-valuetext`, locale from `DSProvider`.  |
| `showValue`                                  | Default `true`.                                                                                  |
| `description`                                | Helper text, linked with `aria-describedby` on the thumb.                                        |
| `name`                                       | Submitted with the form as the number.                                                           |
| `isDisabled`                                 | Dimmed track; the text drops to `--ds-text-3` instead of using opacity so it keeps its contrast. |

#### Accessibility and keyboard

| Key                       | Behavior                                                                 |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ArrowRight` / `ArrowUp`  | Increase by `step`                                                       |
| `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowDown` | Decrease by `step`                                                       |
| `PageUp` / `PageDown`     | Increase / decrease by a larger step (10% of the range, at least `step`) |
| `Home` / `End`            | Minimum / maximum                                                        |

The thumb is `input[type=range]`, named by the label, with `aria-valuetext` from `formatOptions`. The value text is not a live region (RAC announces changes through the input).

#### Content rules

Label with the thing being set ("Discount"), not an instruction. Put the unit in `formatOptions` (`{ style: 'percent' }`, `{ style: 'unit', unit: 'kilometer' }`), never in the label.

#### Example

```tsx
<Slider
  label="Discount"
  name="discount"
  defaultValue={10}
  maxValue={50}
  formatOptions={{ style: 'unit', unit: 'percent' }}
/>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see NumberField: An exact quantity: `NumberField`. Money: `CurrencyInput`.
- Instead, see CurrencyInput: An exact quantity: `NumberField`. Money: `CurrencyInput`.
- Instead, see RadioGroup: Fewer than about five discrete choices: `RadioGroup` or a segmented control.
- Renders: Label

### SourceList

> The numbered list of sources an answer is based on. Each source is a list item that
`Citation` markers jump to; the title is a link when the source has a `url`.

Source numbers are the position in `sources`: keep the order stable while the answer streams,
and append new sources at the end.

The numbered list of sources an answer is based on (`SourceList`) and the inline markers that point to it (`Citation`). Import both from `loui-ds/patterns`.

- Import: `import { SourceList } from 'loui-ds/patterns';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/patterns/SourceList/SourceList.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Patterns/SourceList`): Default, LongText, RightToLeft, WithCitations

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes |  | Id of the list. Required: citations use it to find their source. |
| `sources` | `readonly Source[]` | yes |  | The sources, in citation order. The first is source 1. |
| `title` | `string` |  |  | Heading text. Defaults to "Sources". |
| `headingLevel` | `'1' \| '2' \| '3' \| '4' \| '5' \| '6'` |  | `'3'` | Heading level of the title (`h1` to `h6`). Default `3`. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ title: string; citation: (number: number, title: string) => string; }>` |  |  | Override the built-in messages for this instance. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ SourceList: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Sources` | Default heading of the source list. |
| `citation(number: number, title: string)` | `Source 2: {title}` | Accessible name of a citation marker: "Source 2: Title". |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-bg`, `--ds-citation-size`, `--ds-duration`, `--ds-ease`, `--ds-focus-ring`, `--ds-font-mono`, `--ds-font-sans`, `--ds-fs-label`, `--ds-fs-meta`, `--ds-lh-label`, `--ds-lh-meta`, `--ds-line-control`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-source-list-gap`, `--ds-source-list-indent`, `--ds-source-list-padding`, `--ds-space-1`, `--ds-space-2`, `--ds-text`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-text-3`, `--ds-weight-medium`, `--ds-weight-semibold`

#### When to use

- An assistant answer that rests on documents, pages or records, and the owner should be able to check them.

#### When not to use

- Footnotes in long-form documents: use plain links.
- A list of results the user searched for: use a table or a list of cards.

#### Anatomy

```
p            ... a claim [2] ...        Citation: <a href="#s-source-b" aria-label="Source 2: Title">2</a>
section      named by its heading ("Sources")
  ol
    li       tabIndex=-1 (focus target)    title (link when it has a url) · domain (mono) · snippet
```

#### Accessibility

- A citation is a real link (`href="#..."`) named "Source 2: Title"; the visible text is the number, which the name contains.
- Activating it moves focus to the matching list item and scrolls it into view. It does not change the URL hash, so it does not fight your router. Without JavaScript the hash link still works.
- Source titles with a `url` are links that open in a new tab (with the external-link icon and a screen-reader note).
- The marker is 24 px square (WCAG 2.5.8).

#### Content rules

- Keep source order stable while the answer streams; append new sources at the end, so numbers already shown never change.
- Titles say what the page is, not "Click here". Snippets are short, plain text.

#### Example

```tsx
<p>
  Orders move through four statuses
  <Citation number={1} title="Order lifecycle" listId="answer-1" sourceId="lifecycle" />.
</p>
<SourceList
  id="answer-1"
  sources={[{ id: 'lifecycle', title: 'Order lifecycle', url: 'https://example.com/orders' }]}
/>
```

#### Related components

- Renders: Link

### Sparkline

> A tiny trend line (or area) without axes, drawn in SVG, for tables, stat cards and lists. It
shows the shape of a series, not its values: put the current number next to it.

It is an image with a required text summary (`aria-label`), or `decorative` when the same
information is written next to it. It is not interactive and not focusable. The vertical
range is the data's own minimum to maximum, so a small change on a large number still
shows; use `Chart` when readers need axes, values per point or zero as a reference.

A tiny trend line (or area) without axes, drawn in SVG, for tables, stat cards and lists. It shows the shape of a series, not its values: put the current number next to it.

- TODO `GAP-007`.

- Import: `import { Sparkline } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Sparkline/Sparkline.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Sparkline`): Default, Area, Accent, Success, Warning, Danger, LastValue, MinMax, Larger, IncludeZero, FlatSeries, WithGaps, SinglePoint, Empty, Decorative, NarrowContainer, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `readonly (number \| null \| undefined)[]` | yes |  | The values in display order, usually time. `null`, `undefined` and non-finite numbers are gaps: the line breaks there. An empty array draws nothing. |
| `variant` | `'area' \| 'line'` |  | `'line'` | `line` (default) or `area`, which also fills softly under the line. |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` |  | `'neutral'` | Color of the line: `neutral` (default), `accent`, `success`, `warning` or `danger`. Color is never the only signal: say what the trend means in the accessible name or next to it. |
| `width` | `number` |  | `96` | Width in px (user units). Shrinks to fit a narrower container. Default 96. |
| `height` | `number` |  | `24` | Height in px (user units). Default 24. |
| `showLast` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Draws a solid dot on the last value, the current one. |
| `showMinMax` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Draws hollow markers on the lowest and the highest value (omitted when all values are equal). |
| `includeZero` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Keeps 0 in the vertical range. Default: the range is the data's own minimum to maximum. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Summary of the trend, required unless `decorative` or `aria-labelledby`: "Revenue, last 7 days: up 12%". |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that summarizes the trend. |
| `decorative` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Hides the sparkline from assistive technology. Use it only when the same information is in text next to it (a number and "+12%"): the line alone is never the only source. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `variant`: `area`, `line`
- `tone`: `neutral`, `accent`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-accent`, `--ds-bg`, `--ds-danger`, `--ds-sparkline-area-opacity`, `--ds-sparkline-color`, `--ds-sparkline-dot-r`, `--ds-sparkline-marker-r`, `--ds-sparkline-stroke-w`, `--ds-success`, `--ds-text-2`, `--ds-warning`

#### When to use

- Next to a number in a `StatCard`, a table row or a list item, to show the recent trend.
- When the shape matters more than exact values.

#### When not to use

- When readers need axes, values per point or keyboard exploration: use `Chart`.
- To show a quantity within a range: use `Meter` or `DonutMeter`.
- As the only place a number appears: the sparkline is a summary, not a source.

#### Anatomy

```
svg[role=img] aria-label            (or aria-hidden when decorative)
  path.area                         (variant="area" only)
  path.line                         (one per run of values, a gap starts a new one)
  circle.marker[min|max]            (showMinMax: hollow rings)
  circle.last                       (showLast: solid dot)
```

#### Accessibility

- It is an `img` with a required text summary: say what a sighted reader sees, with the numbers that matter ("Orders, last 7 days: up 12%"). Use `decorative` only when that text is already next to the sparkline.
- It is not focusable and not interactive; there are no tooltips. For exploration use `Chart`.
- Color is never the only signal: tone changes the line color, the trend must be in the name or next to it. Min and max are hollow rings and the last value is a solid dot, so they differ by shape.
- Line, markers and area use `--ds-text-2` or a signal color (3:1 or better on the dark surfaces). Forced colors: everything is drawn in `CanvasText`.
- Under 200% zoom and in narrow containers it shrinks with the container.

#### Content rules

- Summaries are one short sentence in sentence case with the period and the direction: "Revenue, last 30 days: up 8%".

#### Differences from `Chart`

The vertical range is the data's own minimum to maximum, not a "nice" axis that includes zero (`niceScale`), because a trend line on `98, 100, 102` must not be flattened. For that reason `niceScale` and the `Chart` layout helpers are not reused; the geometry lives in `sparklineLayout.ts` and is unit tested.

#### Examples

```tsx
<Sparkline data={daily} aria-label="Orders, last 7 days: up 12%" tone="success" showLast />

<p>
  Orders 1,248 <Sparkline data={daily} decorative /> +12%
</p>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Chart: When readers need axes, values per point or keyboard exploration: use `Chart`.
- Instead, see Meter: To show a quantity within a range: use `Meter` or `DonutMeter`.
- Instead, see DonutMeter: To show a quantity within a range: use `Meter` or `DonutMeter`.

### Spinner

> An indeterminate loading ring that inherits the text color.

It is a `progressbar` without a value, not a live region, so many spinners on a screen do
not each interrupt a screen reader. For large areas prefer `Skeleton`. Under
`prefers-reduced-motion` the ring is static.

An indeterminate loading ring that inherits the text color. Small, quiet, and not a live region.

- Handoff source: `components/feedback/Spinner` (CMP-FBK-06).
- Built on: a plain element with `role="progressbar"`. A pending `Button` wires it as its busy label through React Aria.

- Import: `import { Spinner } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Spinner/Spinner.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/Spinner`): Default, Sizes, WithLabel, DecorativeWithText, InheritsColor

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` |  | `'md'` | Size token: `sm` 14px, `md` 18px (default), `lg` 20px. |
| `label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name. Defaults to the "Loading" message. Say what is loading when it helps ("Loading orders"). |
| `decorative` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Hide the spinner from assistive technology. Use it only when the surrounding UI already announces the busy state (visible status text, `aria-busy` region). Not needed inside a pending `Button`, which wires the spinner as its busy label. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ loading: string; }>` |  |  | Override the built-in messages for this instance. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Variants, sizes and tones

- `size`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ Spinner: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | `Loading` |  |

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-icon-lg`, `--ds-icon-md`, `--ds-icon-sm`, `--ds-radius-pill`, `--ds-spinner-duration`, `--ds-spinner-stroke-width`

#### When to use

- Inside a pending `Button` (`isPending`), which renders it for you.
- Next to a short status text for a small, bounded wait ("Saving changes").
- A single small area that is loading and has no better placeholder.

#### When not to use

- For large areas or page loads: use `Skeleton` so the layout does not jump.
- When you know the progress: use `Progress` with a value.
- As a decoration. It means "busy", so remove it when the work ends.

#### Anatomy

One element: a ring with an open top edge. Size comes from `--ds-icon-sm|md|lg`, thickness from `--ds-spinner-stroke-width`, rotation time from `--ds-spinner-duration`.

#### Accessibility

- `role="progressbar"` with no value (indeterminate) and an accessible name. It is **not** `role="status"` or `aria-live`: a screen reader does not announce every spinner when it mounts. One announcement strategy per screen: the button (`Button` announces pending and done) or a single status region you control.
- Decorative mode: `aria-hidden="true"`. Pair it with visible status text in a `role="status"` region, as in the `DecorativeWithText` story.
- Reduced motion: under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the ring does not rotate. It stays as a static open ring; the accessible name and the busy control state carry the meaning.
- Forced colors: the ring is drawn with `currentColor` borders, which follow the system text color.
- Color: inherits the text color, so it needs no extra contrast treatment beyond its container's.

#### Content rules

- The name is a short noun phrase in sentence case: "Loading", "Loading orders". No ellipsis, no exclamation mark.
- Default text comes from the `Spinner` message catalog (`en`: "Loading", `pt-BR`: "Carregando"). Override it per instance or through `DSProvider messages={{ Spinner: { loading: '...' } }}`.

#### Examples

```tsx
<Spinner />
<Spinner label="Loading orders" size="lg" />

<p role="status">
  <Spinner decorative size="sm" /> Saving changes
</p>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Skeleton: For large areas or page loads: use `Skeleton` so the layout does not jump.
- Instead, see Progress: When you know the progress: use `Progress` with a value.
- Used by: Button, ChatPanel, Combobox, ToolCallStep

### Stack

> Lays its children out in a vertical column with a consistent gap. The gap is a space token
key, never a pixel value. Children can shrink below their content width (`min-inline-size: 0`).

A vertical column of children with one consistent gap. The gap is a key of the space scale, never a pixel value.

- Import: `import { Stack } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/Stack/Stack.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Layout/Stack`): Default, SmallGap, LargeGap, AlignStart, AlignCenter, AlignEnd, AsList, LongText, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gap` | `'1' \| '2' \| '3' \| '4' \| '5' \| '6' \| '8' \| '12' \| '16'` |  | `'4'` | Space between children, as a key of the space scale (`4` = `--ds-space-4` = 16px). Default `4`. |
| `align` | `'center' \| 'start' \| 'end' \| 'stretch'` |  | `'stretch'` | Cross-axis (horizontal) alignment of the children. Default `stretch`. |
| `as` | `'div' \| 'article' \| 'aside' \| 'footer' \| 'form' \| 'header' \| 'li' \| 'main' \| 'nav' \| 'ol' \| 'section' \| 'ul'` |  | `'div'` | Element to render, `div` by default. Use `ul` or `ol` for a list of `li` children: the list reset is applied and `role="list"` keeps the list semantics in Safari. |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Design tokens used

`--ds-space-4`, `--ds-stack-gap`

#### When to use

- Stack blocks of content, fields or cards with the same rhythm.
- A list of items with a uniform gap (`as="ul"`).

#### When not to use

- For a row of items: use `Inline`.
- For a grid of equal cells: use `Grid`.
- To space one pair of elements apart once: a margin from the parent is simpler. Use the layout components for repeated structure.

#### Anatomy

```
div (flex column, gap)
  children
```

#### Accessibility

- A `div` Stack adds no semantics. Choose `as` for the meaning: `ul`/`ol` for lists, `section` with a label for a region.
- `list-style: none` removes list semantics in Safari/VoiceOver, so lists get an explicit `role="list"`.
- Children can shrink below their content width (`min-inline-size: 0`), so long text wraps instead of overflowing at 320px.
- Direction-neutral: `start` and `end` follow the writing direction.

#### Content rules

- None. Stack holds whatever its children are.

#### Examples

```tsx
<Stack gap={6}>
  <Heading level={2}>Account</Heading>
  <Stack gap={3}>
    <Input label="Name" />
    <Input label="Email" />
  </Stack>
</Stack>

<Stack as="ul" gap={2}>
  <li>Orders</li>
  <li>Customers</li>
</Stack>
```

#### Related components

- Instead, see Inline: For a row of items: use `Inline`.
- Instead, see Grid: For a grid of equal cells: use `Grid`.

### StackedBar

> Stacked bars: how each category divides into the same set of parts, horizontal (a row per
category) or vertical (a column per category). Drawn in HTML and CSS, no axis: the total of
each bar is printed with it and the bars share one scale.

Series are told apart without color: a gap separates neighbouring parts, the neutral ramp
differs in lightness, and beyond four series a hatch pattern repeats the ramp. The legend
names every series (and can hide them), and a visually hidden table carries all the numbers.

Each bar is an image with a text summary ("Q1: Online 40 and Store 30. Total 70."). The bars
are one tab stop; the arrow keys move between them, and the active bar's summary is also
printed in a readout line under the chart (hover works the same). A single readout per bar,
not per segment, keeps the keyboard path short and the focus target large.

Stacked bars for parts of a whole per category, horizontal (a row per category) or vertical (a column per category). Each bar has a text summary, a total, and the chart comes with a legend and a hidden data table.

- Import: `import { StackedBar } from 'loui-ds';`
- Status: experimental (do not use in recipes until stable)
- Source: `src/components/StackedBar/StackedBar.tsx`
- Stories (Storybook title `Components/StackedBar`): Default, Vertical, VerticalTall, Normalized, NormalizedVertical, WithCurrency, EightSeries, ExplicitColors, InteractiveLegend, InteractiveLegendControlled, AllSeriesHidden, KeyboardReadout, WithoutLegend, ZeroBar, Empty, LongLabels, PortugueseBrazil, RightToLeft

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `readonly StackedBarDatum[]` | yes |  | One bar per datum, in display order. The chart does not sort. |
| `series` | `readonly StackedBarSeries[]` | yes |  | The parts of each bar, bottom to top (vertical) or start to end (horizontal). Without `color` they follow a neutral ramp of four steps; from the fifth series on the ramp repeats with a hatch (up to eight; beyond that pass `color` or group the tail into "Other"). |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` |  | `'horizontal'` | `horizontal` (default): one row per datum. `vertical`: one column per datum. |
| `normalize` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Draws every bar at full length so each shows the share of its parts (100% stacked). By default bars are scaled to the largest total, so lengths also compare the totals. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` |  |  | Formats values in the totals, the legend, the readout and the data table. Default: `Intl` for the active locale. Use `formatCurrency` for money. |
| `legend` | `boolean` |  | `true` | Shows the legend under the bars. On by default: the legend is what names the series. |
| `interactiveLegend` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Makes the legend items toggle buttons that hide and show series. Hidden series leave the bars, totals, summaries and the data table. |
| `hiddenSeries` | `readonly string[]` |  |  | Controlled list of hidden series ids. |
| `defaultHiddenSeries` | `readonly string[]` |  | `[]` | Initial hidden series ids when uncontrolled. |
| `onHiddenSeriesChange` | `(hiddenSeries: string[]) => void` |  |  | Called with the new list of hidden series ids when the user toggles a legend item. |
| `height` | `string \| number` |  |  | Height of the plot area of a vertical chart (a number is px, or any CSS length). Default `--ds-stacked-bar-height` (200px). Ignored when horizontal. |
| `description` | `string` |  |  | Longer description of what the chart shows. Read after the name, together with the keyboard instructions. |
| `categoryLabel` | `string` |  |  | Header of the category column in the hidden data table. Default: the "Category" message. |
| `messages` | `Partial<{ instructions: (count: number, formatted: string) => string; series: (label: string, value: string) => string; bar: (label: string, items: string, total: string) => string; tableCaption: (name?: string) => string; category: string; total: string; empty: string; allHidden: string; }>` |  |  | Per-instance overrides of the built-in messages. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  | Accessible name of the chart: what it shows ("Orders by channel, per quarter"). Required unless `aria-labelledby` is set. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  | Id of the element that names the chart (a visible heading). |

##### Inherited props

- Standard DOM attributes, ARIA attributes and event handlers; other attributes and `ref` go to the root element.

#### Messages (i18n)

Locales shipped: en, pt-BR. Override per instance with the `messages` prop or globally with `<DSProvider messages={{ StackedBar: { ... } }}>`.

| Key | English default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `instructions(count: number, formatted: string)` | `{formatted} bars. Use the arrow keys to move between bars, Home and End for the first and last.` | Instructions linked to the chart with `aria-describedby`. `count` is the number of bars; `formatted` is the same number formatted for the locale. |
| `series(label: string, value: string)` | `{label} {value}` | One series inside the summary of a bar: "Online 40". Both arguments are already formatted. |
| `bar(label: string, items: string, total: string)` | `{label}: {items}. Total {total}.` | Accessible name of a bar, also shown in the readout. `items` is the list of series joined for the locale ("Online 40 and Store 30"); `total` is the formatted sum of the visible series. |
| `tableCaption(name?: string)` | `Data for {name?}` | Caption of the visually hidden data table. `name` is the accessible name of the chart, if it has a text one. |
| `category` | `Category` | Header of the category column of the data table, unless `categoryLabel` is given. |
| `total` | `Total` | Header of the total column of the data table. |
